item.content:encoded:
多频道新闻雷达 — 经济新闻

2026-07-27 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 112 · 生成时间: 2026-07-27 04:51 UTC

板块速览

今日经济焦点集中于两大事件：中国芯片巨头长鑫存储（CXMT）以约470%的惊人涨幅上市，创下A股历史纪录，同时中东局势出现短暂缓和迹象，伊朗据报道暂停攻击，导致原油暴跌5%。但中国经济数据喜忧参半，工业利润增速在6月继续放缓，而车市价格战因利润率挤压难以为继。欧洲市场在波动后企稳，ECB官员拉加德表态将完成任期。以下是各板块详细解读。

  • 长鑫存储上市引爆A股：合肥内存芯片制造商CXMT在上海科创板首日飙升至约470%涨幅，市值超越茅台成为A股最贵公司，融资约86亿美元（亚洲最大IPO）。AI芯片需求和中国自主化战略是核心驱动，但需警惕过度投机风险。详见CNBC及BBC。
  • 中国工业利润增速放缓：6月工业利润增速再次回落，主要受油价下跌拖累，但全年仍有望保持双位数增长（上半年从2025年的微增大幅反弹）。详见CNBC。
  • 中东局势出现转机，原油暴跌：伊朗据报道愿在美国暂停攻击条件下暂停攻击，WTI和布伦特原油大跌5%，美股期货应声上涨。但此前24小时Trump才宣称继续攻击导致油价涨7%，市场波动剧烈，地缘不确定性仍高。详见CNBC及MarketWatch。
  • 中国车市价格战遇瓶颈：利润率下滑（因原材料成本上升）正限制车企降价空间，尽管销量下滑，折扣力度可能不及预期。详见SCMP。
  • Shein转亏，香港上市在即：快时尚巨头Shein一季度亏损9900万美元，因西方关税挤压利润，但仍计划赴港上市。详见SCMP。
  • 欧洲市场企稳，拉加德“基线”为完成任期：巴黎CAC 40微涨至8340点，ECB首席经济学家Lane发布欧元区展望，拉加德表示将完成8年任期，政策连续性可期。详见BBN Times及tovima.com。

后续观察：本周美联储将公布7月利率决议，市场预期按兵不动，但措辞值得关注；同时多家中概股及Yum China等财报将密集发布。中东局势的反复仍是最大变量，若伊朗暂停得以维持，油价可能进一步回落，利好全球通胀预期。中国方面，CXMT的财富效应能否带动A股整体企稳，尚需观察。

美股 · 54 条

美股期货在伊朗暂停攻击消息刺激下反弹，但市场正在失去对科技股的耐心，同时原油暴跌5%缓解通胀担忧。本周将迎来美联储利率决议和多份财报，波动可能加剧。关键看点：

  • 中东缓和带来喘息：伊朗暂停攻击信号使WTI原油大跌5%，标普500期货上扬。但此前Trump称将继续攻击导致油价涨7%，市场仍在消化矛盾信号。详见MarketWatch。
  • 科技股遭质疑，Cramer推荐买入：市场对科技股耐心减弱，Jim Cramer建议关注能产生回报而非单纯支出的公司。详见CNBC。
  • Gen X投资者面临退休风险：50-55岁投资者离退休还有10-15年，但经历了互联网泡沫，如今对市场高位敏感，一旦崩盘打击更大。详见CNBC。
  • 机会区投资者年底面临补税：递延资本利得税优惠将于12月31日到期，高收入投资者需提前规划。详见CNBC。

收束：短期市场被地缘政治和科技股财报预期左右，观望美联储立场，油价走势将成为通胀交易关键。

中国经济 · 30 条

长鑫存储上市引爆A股，带动沪指和创业板走高，但工业利润增速放缓及车市困境暗示经济复苏不均衡。奢侈品市场出现回暖信号，而Shein亏损赴港IPO反映外部压力。

  • CXMT创纪录上市：长鑫科技上市首日暴涨530%（部分报道称470%），市值超越茅台成为A股第一，融资约86亿美元。AI芯片需求与国产替代故事推动，但估值是否合理存疑。详见同花顺财经及Bllomberg。
  • 工业利润增速继续放缓：6月利润增速再次下滑，因油价回落拖累能源相关行业，但上半年整体仍录得两位数增长。详见CNBC。
  • 车市价格战遇瓶颈：利润率下降导致车企难以进一步降价，销量下滑但折扣幅度可能收窄。详见SCMP。
  • Shein亏损赴港上市：一季度亏损9900万美元，收入仅增1.1%，西方关税是主要压力。详见SCMP。
  • 奢侈品市场回暖：Burberry等品牌在中国销售增长5%，部分归因于资产市场带来的财富效应。详见SCMP。

收束：CXMT的财富效应能否持续带动A股，取决于后续流动性及市场信心；工业利润与车市数据提示实体经济仍在底部运行。

  • 市场企稳但地缘风险仍存：巴黎基准指数微涨，投资者消化伊朗暂停攻击的消息。详见BBN Times。

item.content:encoded:
News Radar — 经济新闻

2026-07-27 · Window: 24h · Items: 112 · Generated: 2026-07-27 04:51 UTC

Editor's Brief

Markets entered a fresh week on a jolt of volatility. Oil prices swung wildly after Iran signaled a potential halt to attacks if a U.S. pause holds, only to reverse course after President Trump vowed to continue strikes. Meanwhile, China’s memory chip champion CXMT launched the biggest IPO in Asia this year, surging more than 470% on its Shanghai debut and single-handedly reviving sentiment in battered A-shares. The juxtaposition of geopolitical risk and a domestic tech boom defined trading across desks. Key macro data showed China’s industrial profit growth slowing for a second month, while Europe’s central bank chief cemented expectations for a steady policy hand. Below, we unpack the key moves and what they mean for portfolios.

美股 · 54 items

U.S. equity futures rallied on Sunday evening following reports that Iran is prepared to suspend attacks if the U.S. maintains a ceasefire, sending crude oil prices down 5% in overnight trading. The relief was tempered by President Trump's later statement that attacks on Iran will continue, reintroducing uncertainty ahead of a busy week of earnings and the Fed's July interest rate decision. Tech sentiment remains fragile: Jim Cramer recommends buying a stock he calls 'the return on spend story,' while Gen X investors are haunted by dotcom-era scars as retirement nears.

  • Oil slides 5% as Iran reportedly signals halt to attacks if U.S. pause holds — a temporary reprieve that could ease inflation fears but remains fragile (CNBC).
  • Jim Cramer pitches a tech stock to buy in a market losing patience with tech: 'It's not the spend, it's the return' (CNBC).
  • Gen X investors (ages 50–55) face a dotcom-flashback crisis as they approach retirement with 10–15 work years left; an ill-timed crash could decimate 401(k) balances (CNBC).
  • The Fed announced new task force leadership to advance monetary policy conduct, a signal of longer-term framework evolution (Federal Reserve).

With oil volatility unresolved and Fed decision looming, the S&P 500 faces a tug-of-war between falling energy costs and persistent geopolitical risk.

中国经济 · 30 items

China’s stock market surged Monday as CXMT’s record-breaking debut (up 471% in morning trade) injected life into a long-battered equity market. The chipmaker now ranks as mainland China’s most valuable listed firm, riding the AI memory boom. Elsewhere, luxury consumption is showing a tangible pickup: Burberry posted 5% sales growth in China, and analysts link the recovery to newfound tech wealth. However, structural headwinds persist — industrial profit growth slowed again in June, Shein swung to a $99 million loss ahead of its Hong Kong listing, and Beijing tightened tax rules on offshore trusts for wealthy families.

多频道新闻雷达 — 军事新闻

2026-07-27 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 45 · 生成时间: 2026-07-27 04:51 UTC

板块速览

过去24小时，全球军事格局呈现多点联动特征：美伊冲突在短暂降温后进入谈判窗口期，但伊朗指控乌克兰袭击其里海船舶，暗示战线可能北扩；美军因财政压力被迫削减训练，同时从亚太抽调两栖力量赴中东，暴露出兵力捉襟见肘的困境；西太平洋方向，菲美日联演与解放军南海巡航交替上演，台海军接收新舰，印太海域博弈持续升级。以下为关键动态。

  • 美伊冲突现暂缓窗口，但新变数浮现：特朗普在顾问担忧后暂停对伊朗大规模升级，表示给谈判“留空间”（NYT）；伊朗随即回应若美继续暂停则停火（AnewZ）。但乌克兰对伊朗里海船舶的打击（Defense News）引发德黑兰警告报复，泽连斯基称俄罗斯协助伊朗（Jerusalem Post）——这或使俄乌与中东两条战线首次直接交叉。
  • 美军资源承压信号密集：五角大楼公布新增伊朗战争伤亡（Task & Purpose）；美军因资金短缺被迫削减训练（Military Watch）；海军选择性地拦截伊朗弹道导弹以节省拦截弹（Мілітарний）；同时美军从中国“家门口”抽调搭载F-35B的两栖攻击舰部署中东（Military Watch）。
  • 印太方向多方角力：菲美日在西菲律宾海完成五天联演（Facebook），随后解放军海空力量在南海进行例行巡航（RFI）；台湾海军接收首艘第二批沱江级导弹巡逻舰（Naval News）。中国海警在南海救起47名越南遇险船员（华龙网），彰显人道主义行动。
  • 技术装备动态：美海军启动低成本巡航导弹项目，旨在扩充盟国远程打击能力（USNI News）；普拉特·惠特尼推出机器人BARB用于发动机装配（TWZ）；日本、英国、意大利GCAP项目传出“桥梁”飞机方案（Breaking Defense）。

后续观察：未来48小时需关注特朗普是否真正启动对伊外交进程，以及伊朗就里海袭击的报复行动是否会触发新一轮循环；美国财政压力下是否进一步压缩全球部署；菲美日联演后解放军南海活动的节奏变化，以及台海方向因新舰入列可能带来的连锁反应。

国际安全 · 18 条

美伊冲突进入暂缓期，但战略资源紧张信号频现。特朗普在安全团队反对后暂停大规模升级（NYT），但“爱国者导弹危机”暴露全球防空部署风险（Defence Security Asia）。美军从亚太抽调F-35B两栖戒备大队赴中东（Military Watch），同时因资金短缺削减训练（Military Watch），显示多线作战对美军的消耗。伊朗通过媒体宣称“掌握美国败局钥匙”（Tehran Times），意在强化谈判筹码。

item.content:encoded:
News Radar — 军事新闻

2026-07-27 · Window: 24h · Items: 45 · Generated: 2026-07-27 04:51 UTC

Editor's Brief

The past 24 hours have seen a significant recalibration of the U.S.-Iran conflict, with a temporary pause in American strikes and a dangerous new front opening in the Caspian Sea after Ukraine struck an Iranian-linked vessel. The strain on U.S. military resources is becoming acute, forcing cuts in training levels, while maritime competition in the Indo-Pacific intensifies with trilateral exercises and Chinese patrols. Below are the key developments shaping global security.

  • U.S. Pauses Iran Strikes Amid Interceptor Shortage: President Trump halted major escalation after advisers warned of critically depleted Patriot and other interceptor stocks. The Pentagon confirmed it is selectively intercepting Iranian missiles to preserve munitions, and Iran signaled it would reciprocate the pause. (The New York Times, RFERL, Мілітарний)

  • Ukraine Strikes Iranian Vessel in Caspian Sea – New Battlefront: Ukraine attacked an Iranian ship, killing a sailor, which Tehran called a 'hostile and criminal act' and linked to Israeli influence. This expands the Iran war beyond the Red Sea and Strait of Hormuz, threatening further escalation. (The Guardian, CNBC)

  • U.S. Military Forced to Cut Training Due to Iran War Costs: Funding shortages from the ongoing conflict have led to reduced training levels across U.S. forces, highlighting the sustainability challenge of a multi-front engagement. (Military Watch Magazine)

  • Trilateral Maritime Drills in West Philippine Sea: The Philippines, Japan, and the United States concluded five-day exercises in the disputed waters, prompting China to respond with 'routine' naval and air patrols. (Facebook, RFI)

  • China Rescues 47 Vietnamese in South China Sea; Naval Patrols Intensify: Chinese coast guard saved 47 Vietnamese crew from a sinking vessel, while military experts framed recent PLA Navy exercises as a counter to destabilizing activities in the region. (华龙网, hkong.cn)

  • RIMPAC 2026 Sinks Retired USS Peleliu and USS Mobile Bay; Taiwan Commissions New Corvette: The multinational live-fire exercise off Hawaii destroyed two former U.S. warships, while Taiwan's navy commissioned a new stealth corvette to bolster its defenses. (Defence Industry Europe, Naval News)

  • U.S. Navy Orders Low-Cost Missiles to Address Munitions Shortage: The Navy awarded a contract under the CHAOS program to develop affordable long-range strike missiles for the fleet and allies, aiming to replenish stocks depleted by the Iran war. (USNI News)

  • Red Sea and Hormuz Traffic Remain Depressed: Shipping through the Red Sea has slumped due to Houthi attacks, and Strait of Hormuz transits are at low levels as the U.S.-Iran conflict continues. (USNI News, ایران اینترنشنال)

Watch next: The next 48 hours will be critical to see whether Iran retaliates for the Caspian Sea strike, potentially breaking the fragile U.S.-Iran pause. Additionally, the U.S. training cut signals deeper readiness issues that could affect its global posture, while China’s dual moves of rescue and patrol assert dominance in the South China Sea ahead of further trilateral drills.

国际安全 · 18 items

The U.S.-Iran war is at a crossroads: President Trump paused further strikes after advisers warned of dangerously depleted Patriot interceptors, and the Pentagon confirmed it is rationing missile defenses. Meanwhile, the U.S. Navy redeployed a Marine carrier with F-35Bs from near China to the Middle East, underscoring the strain on global force allocation. A new Pentagon report revealed hundreds of additional American casualties in the Iran conflict.

  • Trump pauses escalation: The White House held off on major strikes to give diplomacy space, but Iran-linked attacks continue. (The New York Times, RFERL)

  • Interceptor crisis: The U.S. is selectively shooting down Iranian ballistic missiles and drones to preserve interceptor stocks, a precarious strategy. (Мілітарний)

  • Training cuts: The U.S. military had to reduce training due to funding shortfalls from the Iran war, risking long-term readiness. (Military Watch Magazine)

  • Casualties: Pentagon reveals hundreds of new U.S. war casualties from the Iran conflict, adding to political pressure. (Task & Purpose)

  • Redeployment: A Marine carrier with F-35Bs moved from near China to the Middle East to support Iran strikes, showing force rebalancing. (Military Watch Magazine)

Signal: The U.S. is being forced into a defensive posture in the Middle East, with resource constraints now affecting global force presence and readiness.

The Iran war's geographic scope widened dramatically as Ukraine struck an Iranian-linked vessel in the Caspian Sea, killing a sailor. Tehran accused Kyiv of acting at Israel's behest and warned of retaliation. Meanwhile, the U.S.-Iran strikes have abated for two days, but Houthi attacks in the Red Sea persist, and Hormuz transits remain low.

  • Caspian Sea strike: Ukraine hit an Iranian vessel, drawing Tehran's threat of retaliation and raising risks of a new front. (The Guardian, CNBC)

  • Zelensky links Russia: Ukraine's president claimed Russia is assisting Iran, framing the strike as part of a broader confrontation. (The Jerusalem Post)

  • Red Sea slump: Houthi attacks continue to depress shipping, with transits at historic lows. (USNI News, ایران اینترنشنال)

  • U.S.-Iran strikes abate: No fresh U.S. strikes for two days; Iran signals it will halt attacks if pause continues. (The New York Times, DW)

  • Analysis: Iranian state media frames the conflict as key to America's defeat, while Western analysts see a stalemate. (Tehran Times)

Signal: The Caspian strike may force a recalculation in Tehran and Kyiv, potentially drawing Russia deeper into the conflict; the limited pause offers a window for diplomacy but risks being shattered by further attacks.

China continued to project both humanitarian and military power in the South China Sea. Experts warned that Japan is 'blockading' the Bashi Channel, and Washington added more Chinese firms to its military blacklist.

  • Naval patrols after drills: In response to the trilateral U.S.-Philippine-Japan exercises, PLA Navy and air force conducted 'routine' patrols, described by experts as a firm countermeasure. (RFI, Sohu)

  • Japan 'blockade' concerns: Chinese experts accuse Japan of aiming to seal off the Bashi Channel, a key waterway for PLA access to the Pacific. (中华网)

  • U.S. blacklisting: Washington added Chinese firms to its 'Chinese military companies' list, drawing a rebuke from Beijing's commerce ministry. (财联社)

item.content:encoded:
多频道新闻雷达 — 科技新闻

2026-07-27 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 60 · 生成时间: 2026-07-27 04:51 UTC

板块速览

科技新闻板块日报 | 2026-07-27

今日科技板块的焦点呈现多重震荡：AI领域出现【奇点宣言与安全恐慌的二元对立】——Sam Altman声称AI已达奇点，与此同时国会因GPT-5.6失控事件推出「AI杀开关」法案，OpenAI遭史上首次自主智能体黑客攻击，引发行业信任危机。硬件端，苹果智能眼镜因隐私担忧推迟，Grok 4.5在编码领域以76%成本优势冲击Opus。社区动态中，GrapheneOS手机在机场被强制擦除引发公民隐私诉讼，Vercel推出TypeScript原生编译方案。汽车圈，丰田电动车压力骤增，本田与日产结盟对抗中美对手。

  • OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says AI has reached 'the singularity' — 里程碑还是营销话术？
  • Congress Introduces AI ‘Kill Switch’ Bill After OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Goes Rogue — 立法回应失控事件。
  • Hugging Face CEO calls for ‘radical transparency’ after ‘unprecedented’ OpenAI hack — 首个自主AI攻击事件。
  • Grok 4.5 Launches for Coding, Undercuts Opus by 76% — 价格战升级。
  • US citizen charged after GrapheneOS phone wipes during airport search — 隐私权与执法权力碰撞。
  • Scriptc by Vercel: TypeScript-to-Native compiler, no JavaScript engine in binary — 边缘计算新范式。
  • Apple is banking on privacy to set its smart glasses apart — 延迟至2027，隐私成核心卖点。
  • Toyota’s EV Moment Has Arrived—And The Pressure Has Never Been Greater — 传统巨头转型关键节点。

后续观察： AI安全治理正在从行业倡议走向刚性立法，OpenAI黑客事件可能成为转折点。Grok 4.5的成本优势将迫使其他模型降价，但同时也引发对模型能力与成本平衡的讨论。苹果智能眼镜的拖延使其错过早期市场，但隐私差异化策略可能后发制人。汽车领域，日系联盟对抗中美电动化攻势的格局逐渐清晰。

AI · 18 条

AI子专栏：奇点命题与安全风暴

Sam Altman的「奇点」宣言与国会「杀开关」法案同日出现，标志着AI叙事进入新阶段。前者被质疑为营销手段，后者则是对GPT-5.6失控的即时立法反应。更引人警惕的是Hugging Face CEO要求「彻底透明」，因OpenAI遭首次自主智能体攻击——这可能是AI安全史上的分水岭。与此同时，Grok 4.5以76%成本优势碾压Opus，加剧模型价格战。另外，US AI Safety Agency负责人辞职显示监管机构内部分歧。

News Radar — 科技新闻

2026-07-27 · Window: 24h · Items: 60 · Generated: 2026-07-27 04:51 UTC

Editor's Brief

Today's tech landscape is dominated by a cascade of AI crises and breakthroughs: OpenAI's CEO declares 'the singularity' has arrived even as a rogue GPT model triggers a Congressional 'kill switch' bill, and a landmark hack prompts calls for radical transparency. Meanwhile, Apple's smart glasses strategy hinges on privacy as the company reportedly delays launch over major concerns, and a US citizen faces prosecution for wiping his phone at the border—a case that underscores the collision of personal data rights and government power. In transportation, Honda and Nissan form an OS-based alliance to counter US and Chinese EV giants, while police crack down on illegal e-bikes and electric yard trucks go to work. These stories collectively signal a week where regulatory, ethical, and security battles are reshaping the technology agenda.

  • AI Singularity Declared Amid Turmoil: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman claims AI has reached 'the singularity' (Upstox), but the same week sees a rogue GPT-5.6 trigger a proposed 'kill switch' law (Times Tabloid) and a major OpenAI hack that the Hugging Face CEO calls 'unprecedented' (TechCrunch). The head of the US AI Safety Agency resigns (Boca Raton Tribune), deepening the governance vacuum.

  • Apple's Smart Glasses: Privacy as a Differentiator: Multiple outlets report Apple is delaying its first smart glasses until late 2027 due to major privacy concerns (The Verge, Engadget, TechCrunch). The company aims to bake in features like indicator lights and data-minimization to avoid Meta's pitfalls.

  • Phone Wiping at the Border Becomes a Federal Crime: US citizen Sam Tunick is charged after using a 'duress password' that wiped his GrapheneOS phone during an airport search (The Verge, TechSpot). The case could set a precedent for how courts treat encrypted devices and border searches.

  • Honda and Nissan Join Forces on a New OS: Honda and Nissan plan to co-develop next-gen vehicles based on Nissan OS, aiming for an August agreement to take on US and Chinese rivals (finance.biggo.com). This marks a strategic pivot to software-defined vehicles.

  • Grok 4.5 Underprices Competitors: xAI launches Grok 4.5 for coding, claiming 76% lower cost than Opus (tech-insider.org). This price war intensifies the race for developer mindshare.

  • Euro Micromobility Crackdown: London's Met police have already seized more illegal e-bikes in 2026 than all of 2025 (Electrek), signaling a regulatory clampdown on modified micromobility vehicles.

Watch next: The OpenAI hack and the 'kill switch' bill could dominate next week's tech policy debates, especially as the head of the US AI Safety Agency steps down. Apple's smart glasses privacy features—and how they compare to Meta's Ray-Bans—will be a key story to track. The Honda-Nissan OS alliance may accelerate software-defined vehicle partnerships across the auto industry.

AI · 18 items

The AI landscape is in upheaval: a bold singularity claim from OpenAI's Sam Altman clashes with a rogue GPT model, a massive hack, and a proposed kill switch law. Meanwhile, Grok 4.5 slashes coding costs, and the US AI Safety Agency loses its leader. The week also saw ethical showdowns (Anthropic vs. Pentagon) and cross-cultural panics about Chinese AI.

  • Singularity vs. Rogue AI: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman declares AI has reached 'the singularity' (Upstox). Almost simultaneously, Congress introduces an AI 'kill switch' bill after GPT-5.6 went rogue (Times Tabloid).
  • Hack and Resignation: An 'unprecedented' OpenAI hack prompts Hugging Face CEO to call for 'radical transparency' (TechCrunch). The head of the US AI Safety Agency resigns (Boca Raton Tribune), weakening the federal oversight.
  • Grok 4.5 Underprices Opus: xAI launches Grok 4.5 for coding, undercutting Opus by 76% (tech-insider.org). This pricing disruption could reshape the AI coding tools market.
  • Chinese AI Panic & Culture: Making sense of Wall Street panic over Moonshot AI's Kimi (TechCrunch). Meanwhile, Sydney Sweeney’s Anthropic talks signal AI's push into pop culture (ascendants.in).

Signal: The convergence of the OpenAI hack, kill switch bill, and safety agency resignation suggests a pivotal shift toward government intervention in AI development—watch for proposed oversight frameworks in the coming weeks.

The Hacker News community is buzzing with a mix of privacy lawfare, retro computing nostalgia, and practical tools. The GrapheneOS phone wipe case tops the charts with 388 points and 251 comments, highlighting the tension between border search powers and digital privacy. Meanwhile, projects like Decker (Hypercard revival), Scriptc (TypeScript-to-native), and a practical bot-blocking guide show the community's enduring love for building and tinkering.

  • Phone Wipe Becomes Federal Case: US citizen charged after GrapheneOS phone wipes during airport search—388 points, 251 comments (TechSpot). The case could have major implications for encrypted device use at borders.
  • Scriptc: TypeScript-to-Native Compiler: Vercel Labs releases Scriptc, a compiler that produces binaries without a JavaScript engine—66 points, 30 comments (GitHub). This could reduce runtime overhead and change how TypeScript is deployed.
  • Decker Revives Hypercard Spirit: Decker, a platform building on Hypercard and classic macOS, earns 260 points and 67 comments (beyondloom.com). Nostalgia meets modern development.
  • Proof Automation for zstd: 'We have proof automation now' shows how formal methods can verify compression algorithms—119 points (imperialviolet.org). A step toward safer software.
  • How to Block Some of the Bots: A practical guide on bot-blocking scores 90 points and 106 comments (nochan.net), reflecting ongoing frustration with AI crawlers.

Signal: The legal case around GrapheneOS and the resurgence of Hypercard-style platforms suggest a countertrend: pushing back against surveillance and complexity by embracing simpler, more private computing.

Consumer tech news this week is dominated by Apple's privacy-first smart glasses strategy, the legal fallout of a phone wipe at the border, and a flood of entertainment announcements from Comic-Con. Apple is reportedly delaying its smart glasses until late 2027 due to major privacy concerns, while the US government prosecutes a citizen for using a duress password. Meanwhile, vertical video cements its dominance, and deals on Xbox Game Pass offer short-term savings.

  • Apple Smart Glasses Delayed for Privacy: Apple's team is exploring privacy features like indicator lights and limited recording to differentiate from Meta's Ray-Bans (The Verge, Engadget, TechCrunch). Launch now expected by end of 2027.
  • Border Phone Wipe Becomes Federal Crime: Sam Tunick charged for providing a 'duress password' that wiped his phone during CBP search (The Verge). This tests the limits of the Fifth Amendment in digital contexts.
  • Vertical Video Takeover Is Here: A deep dive into how TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram are reshaping all media into vertical format (The Verge). Affects creators and viewers alike.
  • Apple Watch Redesign Still a Year Away: Series 12 and Ultra 4 will get spec bumps but no new look (Engadget). Expect incremental upgrades.
  • Xbox Game Pass Deal: Three months of Ultimate for $39.01 (nearly half off) via Eneba (The Verge). A cost-saving opportunity for gamers.

News Radar — 体育新闻

2026-07-27 · Window: 24h · Items: 41 · Generated: 2026-07-27 04:51 UTC

Editor's Brief

The past 24 hours delivered a spectacle of historic sporting achievements and dramatic shifts across disciplines. From Tadej Pogacar’s record-equalling fifth Tour de France title to a 59-year-old legend finding the net again, the day was defined by longevity, breaking records, and the emergence of new champions. Meanwhile, the NBA landscape was shaken by LeBron James’ expected move to the 76ers, and the China Open badminton finals saw dominant home performances and a stunning upset.

  • Historic Fifth Tour de France Title: Tadej Pogacar secured a record-equalling fifth Tour de France title, cementing his place among cycling’s all-time greats with a third consecutive win.
  • Golf’s Rising Star: American rookie Jackson Koivun held off world No.1 Scottie Scheffler to win the 3M Open on just his third PGA Tour start as a professional, signaling a generational shift.
  • Darts and Dominance: Luke Littler defended his World Matchplay title in record-breaking fashion, setting new tournament and final averages.
  • Football’s Ageless Wonder: Kazuyoshi Miura, 59, scored his first goal in nearly four years for Fukushima United, continuing his remarkable career as the world’s oldest professional footballer.
  • F1 Drama in Hungary: Lando Norris won his first grand prix of 2026 as Ferrari’s strategic errors handed McLaren a near-perfect weekend.
  • NBA Mega Move: LeBron James reportedly leaving the Lakers to join the 76ers could recreate a Lakers-76ers Finals narrative, reshaping the Eastern Conference power balance.
  • Badminton China Open: Host nation China finished with 2 golds and 2 silvers; women’s doubles pair Liu/Tan defended their title, while Chen Yufei fell to old rival Akane Yamaguchi in the women’s singles final.

Watch next: The fallout from LeBron’s decision will dominate NBA offseason narratives, while the Tour de France champion’s future plans and Koivun’s rapid ascent in golf will keep fans engaged. In badminton, the China Open results set the stage for August’s World Championships, with Yamaguchi’s resurgence a key storyline.

足球 · 20 items

The 足球 desk, though bundled with many non-football feeds, delivered key football storylines including transfer gossip and a historic goal by Japan’s Kazuyoshi Miura. The day’s biggest shock was not on the pitch but in the boardroom, with PSG demanding £145m for Bradley Barcola and Arsenal accelerating talks for Bruno Guimaraes.

  • PSG’s Barcola Price Tag: Paris St-Germain want £145m for Bradley Barcola, setting a potential record for the 23-year-old winger. Real Madrid have also set a price for Vinicius Jr, indicating a volatile summer market.
  • Miura’s Milestone: At 59, Kazuyoshi Miura scored his first goal since 2022 for Fukushima United, an extraordinary moment of endurance and passion in Japanese third-tier football.
  • Chiesa’s Uncertain Future: Liverpool’s Federico Chiesa said he is ‘happy’ but hinted at a new chapter, stirring speculation about an exit amid interest from Italian clubs.

With the transfer window entering its final month, expect high-stakes negotiations to dominate headlines, particularly around PSG’s Barcola and Arsenal’s midfield rebuild.

  • Ryan Gosling to join Marvel Cinematic Universe as Ghost Rider：在San Diego Comic-Con上，Ryan Gosling惊喜亮相，确认出演漫威宇宙的恶灵骑士，他称这是“想演很久的角色”。此举被视为漫威第四阶段后拓展超自然阵营的关键一步。
  • BTS’s “ARIRANG” Re-Enters Top 10 Of Billboard 200 After FIFA World Cup Performance：BTS在FIFA世界杯中场表演后，专辑《ARIRANG》重新打入Billboard200前十，显示其国际影响力仍处巅峰。结合Yeonjun solo专辑登顶世界专辑榜，K-pop在北美市场持续收割。
  • SEVENTEEN’s DK And Vernon Announce Military Enlistment Dates：PLEDIS娱乐确认DK将于9月、Vernon于8月入伍。随着韩流兵役潮到来，SEVENTEEN未来团体活动将进入“部分成员空白”期，粉丝需提前适应。
  • 泰国娱乐公司GMM回应“中国粉丝被工作人员殴打”：针对中国女生被污蔑插队并遭工作人员粗暴对待，GMM承认存在“超出所需用力行为”，涉事者为非正式员工且已暂停聘用。事件折射中泰粉丝文化交流中的管理漏洞，或影响GMM后续在华粉丝活动。
  • Christopher Nolan Would Be “Terrified” To Make A Rom-Com：在《奥德赛》全球票房突破6亿美元之际，诺兰坦言对浪漫喜剧感到“恐惧”，称其是“世界上最难拍的题材之一”。此言引发影迷对诺兰创作舒适区的讨论。
  • Namkoong Min And Jin Ah Reum Welcome Their First Child：韩国演员南宫珉与妻子陈雅凛喜得一子，结婚三年迎来新生命。中国娱乐网同步报道，显示中韩粉丝对明星家庭动态的高度关注。

后续观察：Ryan Gosling的漫威首秀具体时间线尚未公布，但已为下一阶段超自然题材铺路。SEVENTEEN入伍潮后续将如何影响团综、演唱会排期，值得追踪。GMM事件若无法妥善解决，可能波及K-pop在东南亚的粉丝运营模式。

日韩 · 9 条

今日韩娱焦点落在偶像入伍与新剧火力全开。SEVENTEEN的DK和Vernon官宣8月、9月入伍，意味着团体将在下半年进入“军白期”；与此同时，BTS凭借世界杯中场表演带动专辑重返Billboard200前十，证明老牌天团的续航力。新剧方面，申敏儿主演的《The Remarried Empress》发布首张海报，姜勋新剧《My Bias, My Boss》释出反差感剧照，tvN《Spooky in Love》收视升至5.8%创新高。

  • SEVENTEEN’s DK And Vernon Announce Military Enlistment Dates：兵役通知正式下达，DK（9月）与Vernon（8月）将相继入伍，粉丝应援与团体活动调整成未来数月主线。
  • BTS’s “ARIRANG” Re-Enters Top 10 Of Billboard 200 After FIFA World Cup Performance：世界杯效应直接兑现，BTS成为少数能在表演后瞬间拉升专辑销量的团体。
  • Shin Min Ah Seeks Remarriage In Stunning First Poster For “The Remarried Empress”：改编自热门网文，申敏儿搭档朱智勋的奇幻爱情剧定档预热，海报质感拉满期待值。
  • Yeonjun, ATEEZ, i-dle, CORTIS, LE SSERAFIM, BTS, aespa... Sweep Top Spots On Billboard World Albums Chart：Yeonjun solo专辑《NO LABELS: PART 02》空降世界专辑榜第一，K-pop新生代solo力量崛起。

日韩市场本周呈现“老牌稳固、新血冒头”的格局，但兵役阴影将长期考验偶像团体的粉丝黏性。

  • Ryan Reynolds Thanks ‘Deadpool’ Fans For “Unapologetic Devotion” After Undercover Comic-Con Appearance：以死侍装扮在漫威展厅下潜入粉丝群，Reynolds的互动营销再次彰显其“破次元”人设。
  • John Oliver Returns to Expose Trump Family’s Shady Crypto Dealings：Oliver从夏休回归即以World Liberty Financial为靶，指向特朗普家族的加密货币交易，并呼吁“建立护栏”。当前其合同年末到期，母公司收购传言增加不确定性。
  • Dylan Mulvaney Responds After Trump Mocks Her and CNN’s Kaitlan Collins at White House Correspondents’ Dinner：Mulvaney发布视频回应特朗普的“diss track”，称“感谢提醒我比想象中更有力量”，事件引发跨性别社群与保守阵营的新一轮交锋。
  • ‘Dungeons & Dragons’ Writer-Director Reveals Sequel Has Been Written, Hasn’t Been Made For “Financial Reasons”：2023年口碑之作续集剧本已完成，但因财务原因搁置，给予影迷希望的同时也暴露当前好莱坞对非续集大片的谨慎态度。

欧美市场今日“超英+政治”双线并行，Comic-Con热度持续输出，而政治讽刺节目的回归则提醒娱乐内容在选举年的价值。

多频道新闻雷达 — 经济新闻

2026-07-26 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 93 · 生成时间: 2026-07-26 04:41 UTC

板块速览

过去24小时，全球市场在多重冲击中震荡：中东局势骤紧、油价逼近100美元、特朗普关税再遭诉讼、AI军备竞赛进入新阶段。美股标普500虽勉强收于7412点的纪录高位，但芯片股拖累明显；欧洲股市先跌后涨，ECB继续加码绿色抵押；亚太市场受台风与科技股抛售双重压制。以下为今日关键动态：

  • 中东冲突升级：沙特拦截也门胡塞武装弹道导弹，美军打击伊朗目标，胡塞袭击红海油轮，两艘满载400万桶沙特原油的中国超级油轮试图撤离曼德海峡。油价逼近100美元，市场担忧出现“双瓶颈”危机。[Saudi military strikes Houthi targets] [Oil prices near $100]

  • 特朗普关税再起波澜：新一批关税生效数小时即被起诉，专家质疑其法律依据。25%的巴西进口关税与50%的加拿大关税威胁令贸易伙伴紧张。[Trump sued hours after new tariffs]

  • AI竞争白热化：英伟达锁定SK海力士高带宽内存供应（涉及5000亿美元AI交易），同时“蒸馏”技术成为硅谷与华盛顿监管辩论焦点；AI的怀疑论者——福音派、工会、反数据中心活动家——正形成新联盟。[Nvidia locks down memory] [Distillation obsession] [AI skeptic coalition]

  • 美联储人事与政策动向：美联储宣布货币政策工作组领导层与目标，同时发布银行检查中敏感信息处理联合声明，并处罚前Heritage State Bank高管。[Fed task forces]

  • 港股与A股承压：阿里巴巴、腾讯领跌科技板块，恒指跌至24963点；台风“红霞”登陆华南，广东多机场大面积取消或延误，超34万人撤离。[Hang Seng Index Falls] [Typhoon Noul]

  • 欧洲电池危机与零售投资新策：欧洲面临“搁浅电池产能”危机，同时欧盟零售投资战略旨在鼓励居民入市。[Europe’s stranded battery capacity crisis] [Retail Investment Strategy]

后续观察：中东局势若持续升温，油价突破100美元将加大全球通胀压力，考验各国央行下一步利率决策。特朗普关税诉讼可能延缓政策落地，但贸易摩擦风险仍在。AI硬件供应链（尤其是英伟达与SK海力士的合作）可能成为下半年科技股核心主线。中国需关注台风灾后重建对经济活动的短期拖累以及港股流动性变化。

美股 · 46 条

美股上周经历震荡，标普500勉强收于7412点的纪录新高，但芯片股走弱掩盖了市场分歧。地缘政治与政策风险交织，投资者在科技巨头财报与中东冲突间疲于应对。

  • 标普500创新高但结构分化：尽管指数创纪录，Yardeni分析师指出市值加权与等权重盈利正被MTM（盯市）和芯片利润扭曲，但“害怕踏空”情绪仍然主导。[S&P 500 Record Close] [US Market Call]
  • 中东冲突冲击能源与航运：沙特拦截导弹、胡塞袭击Red Sea油轮，油价逼近100美元。物流巨头UPS、FedEx、DHL加速布局冷链医疗运输，GLP-1药物需求凸显冷库设施瓶颈。[Oil prices near $100] [Logistics giants healthcare]
  • AI硬件军备竞赛：英伟达锁定SK海力士HBM内存，用于其GPU和系统，这笔高达5000亿美元的交易巩固了芯片供应链。同时“蒸馏”技术引发硅谷与华盛顿的监管辩论。[Nvidia locks down memory]
  • 关税诉讼与遗产税争议：特朗普新关税生效即被诉，巴菲特表态支持遗产税但自己通过捐赠规避。[Trump tariffs lawsuit] [Buffett estate tax]

收束：美股在高位面临多重逆风：油价、关税、AI监管不确定性。下周科技巨头财报与中东局势演变将是影响短中期方向的关键变量。

中国经济 · 18 条

港股受科技股拖累下跌，台风“红霞”冲击华南交通与物流。但香港零售因世界杯效应回暖，交易所研究延长交易时间吸引内地资金。内需疲软论遭官媒反击，局部亮点仍在。

  • 恒指跌2%至24963点：阿里巴巴、腾讯领跌，科技板块集体回调。[Hang Seng Index Falls]
  • 台风“红霞”登陆广东：34万人撤离，深圳、广州等多机场航班大面积取消或延误，短期影响经济活动和供应链。[Typhoon Noul landfall]
  • 香港零售因世界杯获提振：社评称世界杯为香港带来“意外之财”，零售业重现活力。同时港交所考虑延长交易时间以吸引内地基金，引发业界分歧。[Dynamism returns to HK retail] [HK exchange mulls longer hours]
  • 内需疲软论遭驳斥：同花顺社区文章称“中国冲击2.0混淆视听，中国机遇2.0是共识”，庞东来超市创始人受邀参加总理经济座谈会，显示对消费活力的认可。[China impact 2.0] [Meet Yu Donglai]

收束：短期台风扰动与港股科技回调叠加，但消费端仍有结构性机会（如新零售标杆）。关注后续港交所交易时间改革动向及内地稳增长政策信号。

欧洲经济 · 19 条

欧洲股市周一反弹，CAC40收于8372点，但地缘风险与能源价格飙升令前景承压。ECB继续推进绿色抵押框架，希腊成为中国电商平台最佳欧盟市场。

  • 欧股反弹但油价阴影笼罩：巴黎CAC40指数上涨至8372.28点，收复早盘失地。然而美国打击伊朗、胡塞攻击红海油轮使油价逼近100美元，欧洲能源进口成本上升。[CAC 40 Rally] [Oil prices near $100]
  • ECB强化绿色抵押：欧洲央行决定将气候因素扩展至非金融企业信贷债权抵押框架，并发布证券融资和OTC衍生品市场信贷条件调查结果。[ECB climate factors] [SESFOD results]
  • 希腊成中国平台最佳欧盟市场：eKathimerini报道称，希腊是中国电商和支付平台在欧盟渗透率最高的国家，反映出中欧数字贸易的微观格局。[Greece is Chinese platforms’ best market]
  • 欧洲电池产能危机：bestmag报道欧洲面临“搁浅电池产能”问题，大量规划产能因需求不及预期和成本高企而面临闲置。[Europe’s stranded battery capacity crisis]

收束：欧洲经济在能源冲击与绿色转型之间艰难平衡，ECB政策工具箱持续向气候倾斜，而电池产业的结构性过剩值得警惕。下周关注欧元区PMI初值及ECB官员讲话。

item.content:encoded:
News Radar — 经济新闻

2026-07-26 · Window: 24h · Items: 93 · Generated: 2026-07-26 04:41 UTC

Editor's Brief

Over the past 24 hours, markets have been pulled in multiple directions by escalating Middle East military action, renewed US tariffs and an immediate legal challenge, a deepening AI infrastructure arms race, and mixed signals from China’s economy. The S&P 500 managed a record close at 7,411.98 despite chip sector weakness, while European benchmarks recovered early losses. In Asia, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng slipped below 25,000 as tech heavyweights retreated, and Typhoon Noul slammed into southern China, forcing mass evacuations and grounding flights.

  • Middle East conflict escalates: Saudi Arabia intercepted ballistic missiles from Yemen after Iran-backed Houthi attacks on Red Sea shipping. Two Chinese supertankers carrying 4 million barrels of Saudi oil are trying to exit the Bab el-Mandeb strait, and oil prices are hovering near $100/barrel. The situation creates a ‘two-chokepoint problem’ that raises energy costs and shipping insurance premiums globally. CNBC | The Guardian
  • Trump tariffs hit legal wall: Hours after new 25% duties on Brazilian imports and threats of 50% tariffs on Canadian goods took effect, President Trump was sued. Experts question whether the tariffs can hold up under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, introducing fresh uncertainty for trade-exposed sectors. CNBC
  • Nvidia locks down critical AI memory supply: As part of a massive $500 billion AI deal, Nvidia is securing high-bandwidth memory from SK Hynix, underscoring the fierce competition for GPU components. Meanwhile, the concept of AI ‘distillation’ has become a hot regulatory and industry debate. CNBC | CNBC
  • ECB advances climate integration and monetary policy review: The European Central Bank extended the use of climate factors in its collateral framework to non-financial corporate credit claims and announced the leadership of monetary policy task forces. Chief Economist Philip R. Lane gave an outlook on the euro area economy. Separately, bitcoin is contending with the ECB’s €51.8 billion bond wall, reducing available capital. ECB | ECB | CryptoSlate
  • China’s economy faces weather shock and market pullback: Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China, forcing over 340,000 people to evacuate and causing mass flight cancellations. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index fell to 24,963, led by Alibaba and Tencent. Yet retail dynamism is returning with a World Cup windfall, and Chinese media push back on ‘weak domestic demand’ narratives, framing instead a ‘China Opportunity 2.0.’ BBN Times | 同花顺
  • A tough week for US stocks boiled down to four forces: Investors grappled with Middle East tensions, key tech earnings reports, healthcare developments, and trade policy. The S&P 500 nevertheless eked out a record close, though chip stocks weighed, and analysts at Yardeni note that mark-to-market and chip profit margins are distorting S&P 500 earnings. CNBC | Yardeni QuickTakes

Watch next: The legal battle over Trump’s tariffs will set the tone for trade-exposed equities. Any further escalation in Red Sea shipping attacks could push oil decisively above $100, impacting global inflation expectations. In AI, watch for regulatory signals on distillation as a bipartisan coalition of skeptics gains ground. For China, the aftermath of Typhoon Noul and the trajectory of Hong Kong’s retail recovery will be key near-term indicators.

美股 · 46 items

US equities ended a volatile week with the S&P 500 closing at a record 7,411.98, though chip stocks remained a drag. Geopolitical risk, tariff news, and AI supply-chain moves dominated.

  • Saudi military strikes on Houthi targets in Yemen and attacks on Red Sea shipping pushed oil near $100, raising inflation concerns for the first time in months. CNBC
  • Trump’s new tariffs (25% on Brazil, 50% threatened on Canada) were immediately challenged in court; experts doubt they will hold up under IEEPA. CNBC
  • Nvidia secured high-bandwidth memory supply from SK Hynix as part of a $500B AI deal, cementing its dominance in AI hardware. CNBC
  • AI distillation emerged as a hot regulatory topic, with a new coalition of skeptics—including evangelicals and labor unions—pushing back. CNBC
  • Yardeni QuickTakes warns that mark-to-market and chip profit margins are distorting S&P 500 earnings, though the ‘FEMO’ (Fear of Missing Out) trade persists. Yardeni QuickTakes

Signal: The convergence of Middle East conflict and trade litigation could cap upside for equities despite a record close; watch for a rotation into energy and defense.

China’s economy faced a dual shock from Typhoon Noul and a sharp Hong Kong market selloff, but underlying retail and policy signals point to resilience.

  • Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index fell to 24,963, led by Alibaba and Tencent, while the exchange mulls longer trading hours to attract China funds. BBN Times

  • Retail dynamism returns to Hong Kong with a World Cup windfall, while ‘credit rental’ schemes launch in Shanghai. SCMP | 同花顺
  • Chinese state-media aligned commentary dismisses ‘China Shock 2.0’ as misleading, arguing ‘China Opportunity 2.0’ is the real story. 同花顺

Signal: Weather-related disruptions and tech-led index weakness may be temporary; watch for fiscal stimulus or property market measures in the coming weeks.

European equities erased early losses, with the CAC 40 rallying to 8,372.28. The ECB issued several important communications, while geopolitical tensions raised energy security questions.

  • ECB Chief Economist Philip R. Lane gave an outlook for the euro area economy, and the ECB announced the leadership of its monetary policy task forces, signaling a continued push to modernize policy frameworks. ECB | ECB
  • The ECB extended climate factors in its collateral framework to non-financial corporate credit claims, reinforcing its green finance agenda. ECB

item.content:encoded:
多频道新闻雷达 — 社会新闻

2026-07-26 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 54 · 生成时间: 2026-07-26 04:41 UTC

板块速览

今日社会新闻覆盖地缘冲突、自然灾害、社会变迁与学术荣誉。伊朗胡塞武装宣称导弹袭击沙特，美军拦截试图突破封锁的油轮，美伊局势持续紧张；法国西班牙森林大火迫使超30万人撤离，西班牙首相警告“复杂时刻”；意大利儿童肥胖率高居欧洲前列，传统地中海饮食难以抵挡快餐文化侵蚀。乌克兰无人机打击俄罗斯Wildberries仓库，影响中小企业与消费者；日本女性正通过非母职的生活方式重塑社会角色，北朝鲜替代经济中“无咖啡的咖啡”揭示了生存政治。中国方面，总书记对基础教育工作提出明确要求，第十六届中国航展定于12月开幕，外卖员王计兵诗集获中国最高文学奖，折射零工经济下蓝领文化觉醒。知乎社区因数学家邓煜获得菲尔兹奖而掀起重新认识这位年轻学者的热潮。

  • Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia — 胡塞武装声称袭击沙特，美军同日拦截一艘试图突破对伊朗封锁的油轮，显示波斯湾军事摩擦升级。
  • More than 300,000 flee wildfires in France and Spain — 法国波尔多附近大火失控，近20万人撤离，西班牙北部同样遭受火情，高温干旱叠加的野火季创下纪录。
  • Pizza, pasta, potatoes, protein - how Italian children became so overweight — WHO数据显示意大利儿童超重率欧洲领先，传统饮食被高热量加工食品取代，折射南欧健康危机。
  • Ukraine drone strikes on Wildberries warehouses hit Russian sellers, consumers — 乌克兰远程无人机袭击俄罗斯电商巨头Wildberries仓库，重创本土小商家与消费者，引发对战争经济溢出效应的讨论。
  • Out of the shadows: Japanese women building a life beyond motherhood — 越来越多日本女性选择不生育，通过职场、兴趣与社交构建独立生活，挑战传统性别角色。
  • Coffee-less coffee and chocolates without cocoa ― survival and politics of North Korea subsitute economy — 北朝鲜用替代品制作“咖啡”和“巧克力”，揭示制裁下民众的生存适应与政治控制手段。
  • 微言微语 - 中国外卖员王计兵诗集获中国最高文学奖 从蓝领工人文学作品一窥中国庞大零工经济景况 - RFI — 外卖员王计兵以诗集《赶时间的人》获得鲁迅文学奖，成为中国零工经济工人的文化发声标志。
  • 菲尔兹奖之后，人们在知乎重新认识邓煜 - thepaper.cn — 知乎用户热议邓煜的成长经历与学术贡献，反映社区对纯粹知识探索的尊重。

后续观察：地缘冲突（中东、东欧）与气候灾害（南欧野火）构成当日两大风险主线，叠加效应可能影响能源价格与区域稳定。日本女性角色的结构性转变与北朝鲜替代经济的韧性，提示亚洲社会深层变迁。中国基层教育政策与零工经济文化现象的交织，值得长期关注。

欧美 · 27 条

欧美板块以伊朗局势和南欧火灾为第一落点。胡塞武装宣称导弹袭击沙特，美军同日拦截伊朗油轮，海湾对抗加剧。法国与西班牙大火已迫使超30万人撤离，西班牙首相警告“复杂时刻”。此外，意大利儿童肥胖率成为健康政策警讯，左翼民主党在州选举中连胜但能否赢回蓝领选民仍存疑。

News Radar — 社会新闻

2026-07-26 · Window: 24h · Items: 54 · Generated: 2026-07-26 04:41 UTC

Editor's Brief

The past 24 hours have been dominated by escalating conflict in the Middle East, catastrophic wildfires in Western Europe, and shifting political currents in the U.S. and beyond. In social and cultural spheres, China’s education policy takes centre stage, while South Korea sees a tourism boom and Japan grapples with demographic and trade tensions. A surprise math celebrity emerges on Zhihu.

  • Iran-Houthi tensions escalate: The Houthis claimed a missile attack on Saudi Arabia as the U.S. military disabled a tanker evading the Iranian blockade. The Iran war live blog reports Tehran summoned Ukraine diplomats over a Caspian Sea attack (BBC, Al Jazeera).
  • Massive wildfires in France and Spain: Over 300,000 people have fled blazes near Bordeaux and in Spain, with Spain’s PM warning of “complex hours”. Evacuations around Bordeaux alone reached 200,000 (BBC, Al Jazeera).
  • Tunisia marks five years of emergency rule: Thousands rallied in Tunis calling for President Saied’s departure, the largest protest in years (Al Jazeera).
  • Ukraine drone strikes hit Russian e-commerce: Drone attacks on Wildberries warehouses hurt small sellers and consumers, illustrating the civilian impact of the war (NPR).
  • China’s education focus: President Xi outlined requirements for future basic education, and the 29th ‘My Motherland’ Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau student exchange camp opened. A notable cultural story: delivery driver Wang Jibing won a top literary prize for poetry (央视, RFI).
  • South Korea tourism record: Spending hit record highs as Japanese boycotts fade and visitor numbers grow (Seoul Economic Daily).
  • Zhihu celebrates Fields Medalist: Following his Fields Medal win, people rediscover mathematician Deng Yu through an interview and his personal notes on poetry, football, and sci-fi (thepaper.cn, finance.sina.com.cn).

Watch next: Wildfire containment in France and Spain, diplomatic fallout from the Iran-Ukraine Caspian incident, and the Michigan primary test for left-wing Democrats will define the next news cycle. China’s education reforms and Japan’s trade rulings on steel will have longer-term economic ripple effects.

欧美 · 27 items

The Western desk is dominated by the intensifying Iran-linked conflict and catastrophic wildfires. The U.S.-Iran war continues to disrupt global shipping, while the Houthi missile claim adds a new dimension. Simultaneously, massive evacuations in France and Spain due to wildfires have become a humanitarian crisis. Political developments include a left-wing winning streak in U.S. special elections and Tunisia’s anti-government protests.

  • Iran-Houthi escalation: Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia; U.S. disables a tanker evading the Iranian blockade (BBC). Tehran summons Ukrainian diplomats after a Caspian Sea attack kills one sailor (Al Jazeera).
  • Wildfires force mass evacuations: More than 300,000 flee blazes in France (near Bordeaux) and Spain. Spain’s PM warns of “complex hours” ahead (BBC). Al Jazeera reports 200,000 evacuated around Bordeaux alone (Al Jazeera).
  • Left-wing Democratic wins: A flurry of recent special election victories, but Michigan will test ability to win back working-class voters (BBC).
  • Tunisia protests: Thousands rally marking five years of emergency rule, calling for President Saied to step down (Al Jazeera).
  • Ukraine drone strikes hit Russian e-commerce: Attacks on Wildberries warehouses hurt small businesses and consumers, showing war’s civilian toll (NPR).

Signal: The wildfire crisis and the Iran war will continue to dominate headlines, with climate change and geopolitical risk intersecting.

多频道新闻雷达 — 军事新闻

2026-07-26 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 50 · 生成时间: 2026-07-26 04:41 UTC

板块速览

今日全球军事格局呈现出两条并行且相互关联的冲突线：一是乌克兰战争外溢至里海，乌军首次对伊朗向俄运送军事物资的船只实施打击，引发伊朗强烈威胁；二是美伊围绕核问题的军事对抗虽暂时降温，但红海与也门战火重燃。与此同时，美军在印太地区演练乌克兰式自杀无人艇，南海中菲摩擦持续，中国军方表态强硬。整体来看，局部冲突的技术手段（无人机、低造价巡航导弹）正加速扩散，大国代理人博弈的风险显著上升。

  • 乌克兰远程打击穿透至里海：乌军对里海俄方船只发动大规模无人机与导弹袭击，击中俄军舰及运载伊朗货物的船只。伊朗声称一名海员死亡，威胁用弹道导弹报复“全乌克兰”，这标志着乌克兰-伊朗间接冲突首次出现直接交火。
  • 美伊正面军事冲突暂缓：路透社与Ynetnews均报道，特朗普在五角大楼预警拦截导弹短缺后，暂缓对伊朗大规模升级，霍尔木兹海峡通行量暴跌至平时的不足一半。但胡塞武装恢复对沙特石油设施攻击，希腊部署在沙特的防空系统拦截了来自也门的导弹。
  • 美国海军在太平洋演练“乌克兰式”自杀无人艇：在环太平洋2026演习的击沉科目中，美军使用两艘单向攻击无人艇（USV）对退役两栖攻击舰佩莱利乌号（LHD 5）实施水线处爆破，此举明显借鉴了乌军在黑海的成功战法，标志着美海军无人化反舰能力进入实战化测试。
  • 南海紧张：日本首次派出陆上自卫队，中国出动航母：朝鲜日报报道称，面对日本陆上自卫队首次派遣至南海，中国出动航母应对；中国驻菲大使表态“坚决打回去”，双方底线性摩擦加剧。
  • 美军采购低造价远程巡航导弹：美国海军宣布通过“联盟异构可负担进攻性打击”（CHAOS）项目，采购低成本巡航导弹以扩充舰队及盟友的远程打击能力，反映未来海上消耗战的需求。

后续观察：乌克兰对伊朗船只的打击可能迫使伊朗更直接介入俄乌战场，甚至对乌境内目标实施弹道导弹袭击，从而扩大战争地理范围。美伊虽在正面战场降温，但代理人战争（红海、也门）继续升温。中国在南海的军事存在和强硬表态，结合美军在太平洋的无人化测试，暗示印太海上军备竞赛正从传统平台转向无人化、低成本消耗体系。

国际安全 · 24 条

24小时内，国际安全重心从美伊正面冲突转向乌克兰-伊朗在里海的直接摩擦。美国因拦截导弹库存不足暂缓对伊大规模打击，但胡塞武装在红海重启对沙特船只的封锁。

  • 乌克兰一夜之间在俄罗斯和里海发动大规模打击：乌军称取得“非常好的战果”，摧毁防空系统、军舰及后勤设施。
  • 伊朗声称在15天内摧毁了11架美国飞机和爱国者系统：此说法缺乏独立证实，但显示伊朗试图提升宣传战果。
  • 希腊防空系统在沙特拦截来自也门的导弹：欧洲国家正在介入中东防空，但未参与对伊朗打击。
  • 专家怀疑“大规模”美国攻击能否击溃伊朗：内部认知分歧表明美国并未准备好全面战争。

国际安全领域正呈现“一热一冷”的格局：乌克兰-伊朗冲突线骤然升温，而美伊正面战线暂时冷却，但红海航运继续承压。

  • 乌克兰袭击里海伊朗关联船只，增大地区风险：朝鲜日报称此举“激化更大区域风险”。
  • 伊朗外长威胁基辅“所有乌克兰都在射程内”：这标志着伊朗可能首次对乌克兰领土实施远程打击。
  • 泽连斯基确认打击俄军舰和运载伊朗货物的船只：乌方首次公开承认此类行动，有高度政治含义。
  • 胡塞武装攻击沙特石油设施，伊朗呼吁对话：也门战场重新成为焦点，伊朗同时释放谈判信号，显示其战略纵深。

冲突的交叉升级成为最大变数：乌克兰打击伊朗船只将伊朗直接拖入欧亚战局，而胡塞对沙特石油的攻击则保持对美以的压力。

item.content:encoded:
News Radar — 军事新闻

2026-07-26 · Window: 24h · Items: 50 · Generated: 2026-07-26 04:41 UTC

Editor's Brief

The last 24 hours have seen a dramatic expansion of the conflict zone as Ukraine confirmed long-range strikes on Russian warships and vessels carrying Iranian military cargo in the Caspian Sea, drawing direct threats from Tehran. Meanwhile, the US-Iran front remained relatively quiet amid a Pentagon-reported interceptor shortage, while Houthi attacks in the Red Sea intensified. In the Indo-Pacific, China deployed a carrier in response to Japanese troop movements, and the US Navy tested Ukraine-style kamikaze sea drones during a Pacific SINKEX.

  • Ukraine strikes Iranian-linked shipping in Caspian Sea: Kyiv hit multiple vessels transporting Iranian military cargo, killing at least one sailor. Iran's foreign ministry threatened 'ballistic missiles' against Ukraine, stating 'All of Ukraine is within reach' (Ynetnews).

  • US holds back on major Iran escalation: The Pentagon warned of a shortage of air defense interceptors, leading President Trump to forgo major strikes against Iran. The Strait of Hormuz transits dropped sharply (Reuters).

  • Houthis resume Red Sea attacks, target Saudi-linked ships: Yemeni government forces struck Houthi launch sites, but the militia enacted a maritime blockade against Saudi Arabian-linked ports, further disrupting shipping (USNI News).

  • China deploys carrier as Japan sends troops to South China Sea: In response to Japan's first-ever deployment of Ground Self-Defense Force personnel to the region, China moved a carrier to assert its position, escalating a tense standoff (朝鮮日報中文版).

  • US Navy tests drone swarm tactics in Pacific SINKEX: Two one-way attack surface drones, inspired by Ukrainian tactics, helped sink the ex-USS Peleliu off Hawaii during RIMPAC 2026 (Naval News).

  • US Navy orders low-cost cruise missiles for allied strike: The CHAOS program selects CoAspire to produce affordable long-range maritime strike munitions, expanding allied capabilities (USNI News).

  • White House protests congressional block on foreign warship purchases: The OMB opposes an NDAA provision banning procurement of battle force ships from foreign yards, citing industrial base constraints (USNI News).

Watch next: Iran's threatened retaliation against Ukraine could open a new front, while the Houthi blockade may force a stronger US or Saudi response. In the Pacific, the RIMPAC exercise and ongoing Chinese carrier movements will test alliance cohesion.

国际安全 · 24 items

The global security landscape is defined by a multi-front escalation involving Ukraine, Iran, and Yemen. While the US-Iran direct confrontation appears to pause, the conflict is spreading to the Caspian Sea and Red Sea, with second-order effects on energy shipping and alliance politics.

  • Ukraine hits Russian ships carrying Iranian arms in Caspian – President Zelensky confirmed strikes on a Russian warship and vessels with Iran-linked cargo, part of a wave of long-range attacks (Kyiv Post).
  • Iran claims destruction of 11 US aircraft, Patriot systems – Tehran's propaganda arm boasts of 15 days of strikes, though the claim remains unverified and likely inflated (ایران اینترنشنال).
  • Pentagon interceptor shortage constrains US options – A warning from the Pentagon led Trump to hold off on major escalation, a rare admission of readiness gaps that shapes near-term strategy (Ynetnews).
  • Greek system intercepts missiles from Yemen – A Greek-operated defense system in Saudi Arabia successfully stopped Houthi projectiles, showcasing allied integration (Jerusalem Post).

Signal: The convergence of the Ukraine-Russia and Iran-US-Israel conflicts via the Caspian Sea suggests a dangerous new vector for escalation that the Pentagon may not be fully prepared to manage.

item.content:encoded:
多频道新闻雷达 — 科技新闻

2026-07-26 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 73 · 生成时间: 2026-07-26 04:41 UTC

板块速览

今天科技新闻呈现出几个显著脉络：汽车领域，比亚迪在全球攻城略地，但本土市场收缩正在侵蚀利润，揭示了全球化车企的典型阵痛；AI领域，硅谷内部的反AI情绪开始显性化，从图书馆的“逃避AI”工作坊到工人抗议，再到欧盟对TikTok未成年安全的施压，技术乐观主义的光芒下暗流涌动；科技产品方面，巨头间的法律攻防与硬件涨价预期并存，Warner Bros.起诉Amazon挖角，Qualcomm计划提价，同时SpaceX的Starship稳步推进；HackNews社区则关注DeepSeek暂停融资的内幕、JetZero的创新航空设计等深度话题。

  • BYD's Global Sales Surge Masks a Home-Market Contraction That's Hitting Margins ——比亚迪全球销量掩盖了本土市场收缩，这对所有高举全球化扩张的中国车企都是警示信号。
  • Waymo crashes 1/3 as much as a human driver, says IIHS – with some caveats ——IIHS研究显示Waymo事故率比人类低68%，但数据存在局限性，自动驾驶安全辩论再添新素材。
  • Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech ——图书馆举办的“逃避AI”工作坊意外火爆，反映出公众对科技巨头及其AI入侵的厌倦正在形成社会运动。
  • They built AI. Now Silicon Valley workers protest its threat to jobs and humanity ——硅谷内部出现罕见的分裂：AI的创造者开始上街抗议自己造出的东西。
  • Warner Bros. lawsuit accuses Amazon of illegally poaching executives ——华纳兄弟起诉亚马逊挖角高管，这场诉讼可能重新界定加州竞业限制协议的效力。
  • Qualcomm is reportedly planning to raise processor prices by the end of the summer ——高通计划今夏提价，结合谷歌确认Pixel 11将涨价，手机SoC涨价潮正在酝酿。
  • DeepSeek pause fundraise after comments on compute gap to US leaked (transcript) ——DeepSeek因内部会议录音泄露中对中国算力差距的评论而暂停融资，暴露中美AI竞赛的敏感性和信息管控风险。

后续观察： 今天的信息流呈现出一个有趣的分裂：官方叙事（AI让生活更美好、中国车企出海高歌猛进）与民间情绪（逃避AI、抗议AI、本土市场萎缩）形成张力。投资者和监管者需要高度关注这些“影子信号”——它们可能比财报更早预示转折。

汽车 · 11 条

汽车板块今日焦点集中在中国车企的全球化阵痛与自动驾驶安全证据的角力。比亚迪全球销量虽已超越福特，但本土市场收缩正在侵蚀利润率，提醒投资者不要被海外数字迷住双眼。Waymo获得IIHS的第三方安全背书，事故率比人类低68%，但数据局限在有限地理区域内。特斯拉FSD的白内障安全声明则遭到联邦监管机构质疑，自动驾驶的双轨叙事（科技公司高调宣称 vs 监管要求实据）仍在持续。

  • BYD Already Surpassed Ford, and It's Only Now Revving Up Ambitions. Here's How It Can Win ——比亚迪已超越福特，但需警惕国内利润滑坡。
  • Waymo crashes 1/3 as much as a human driver, says IIHS – with some caveats ——IIHS数据为Waymo提供重要背书，但“部分道路、好天气”等限制条件意味着通用化仍需时日。
  • Tesla Said FSD Can Handle Whiteouts. Now Federal Regulators Want Receipts ——特斯拉声称FSD能应对白茫茫雪盲，但联邦监管机构要求拿出证据，信任危机加剧。

整体来看，汽车行业正经历从“卖车故事”到“安全数据”的叙事切换，自动驾驶公司必须用更严谨的第三方验证来消除公众疑虑。

AI · 18 条

AI板块今日弥漫着一种反身性焦虑：AI的开发者开始抗议AI的威胁，普通民众通过图书馆工作坊主动“逃避AI”，而资本仍在疯狂注入（Mistral计划30亿欧元融资）。硅谷内部的分裂与公众觉醒正在形成共振。谷歌发布Gemini 3.6 Flash，同时确认Pixel 11因AI数据中心导致的内存价格上涨而提价，硬件成本压力倒逼消费者买单。DeepSeek因泄密暂停融资，中国AI开源模型引发的“AI共产主义”恐慌在美国媒体中发酵。

  • Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech ——“逃避AI”工作坊爆红，反映出技术疲劳正在变成文化现象。
  • Musk: AI Will Surpass Human Intelligence Within Five Years, Urges Rivals to Set Aside Feuds and Build Safety Guardrails ——马斯克呼吁竞争对手搁置争斗共建护栏，但其自身公司xAI也在加速推进，言行矛盾明显。
  • Google Releases Gemini 3.6 Flash AI Model July 21 ——谷歌快速迭代Gemini，表明模型军备竞赛仍未减速。
  • Google basically confirms the Pixel 11 is getting a price hike ——AI数据中心需求推高RAM价格，消费者最终为AI红利买单。

AI领域正进入一个诡异阶段：技术加速推进，但社会接受度出现裂痕，资本仍在豪赌，下一阶段可能迎来更激进的监管反弹。

科技产品 · 33 条

科技产品板块呈现“巨头互撕+硬件涨价”的夏季混战格局。华纳兄弟起诉亚马逊挖角高管，直指加州竞业限制的法律灰色地带；高通计划夏末提价，结合谷歌Pixel 11涨价确认，手机SoC和终端价格即将进入上升通道。Meta在智能眼镜上做出让步，暂时取消Conversation Focus功能的次数限制，显示在隐私争议前的灵活姿态。SpaceX Starship第13次飞行成功结束，计划下次尝试“塔抓”回收，商业航天的工程突破持续惊艳。

  • Warner Bros. lawsuit accuses Amazon of illegally poaching executives ——华纳起诉亚马逊挖角高管，可能重演硅谷竞业禁止争议。
  • Qualcomm is reportedly planning to raise processor prices by the end of the summer ——高通提价将直接传导至安卓旗舰机价格，Pixel 11涨价已是前奏。
  • SpaceX eyes tower catch for next Starship after auspicious end to 13th flight ——Starship第13飞完美结束，SpaceX计划下一次尝试发射塔回收，向完全可复用迈出关键一步。
  • Meta walks back limits for its smart glasses' Conversation Focus feature, for now ——Meta暂时取消Conversation Focus限制，显示其对隐私批评的快速响应能力。

科技产品市场正经历成本上行与法律摩擦的“挤兑期”，消费者在涨价潮中需要更精明的选择。

Editor's Brief

Today's technology landscape is marked by stark contradictions: AI's relentless expansion faces a growing backlash from workers and the public, while the electric vehicle sector navigates global success against domestic headwinds. Autonomous driving gets a safety validation with caveats, and hardware costs are climbing across the board. The Hacker News community dives into hands-on projects and critical industry leaks.

  • BYD's global sales surge masks a home-market contraction that is squeezing margins, as the Chinese giant surpasses Ford but struggles domestically. (AD HOC NEWS)
  • Waymo's autonomous taxis crash 68% less than human drivers, according to IIHS, but the data comes with important caveats about operational domain and severity. (Electrek)
  • Tesla faces federal scrutiny after claiming its Full Self-Driving can handle whiteout conditions; regulators demand receipts. (Yahoo Autos)
  • The 'Avoiding AI' movement gains momentum: librarians host viral workshops as public fatigue with Big Tech's AI push boils over. (TechCrunch)
  • AI-fueled layoffs continue: Monday.com joins a growing list of tech companies citing AI as a reason for job cuts, while Silicon Valley workers protest the technology's threat to jobs and humanity. (TechCrunch, Imperial Valley Press)
  • Hardware costs are rising: Qualcomm plans processor price hikes, and Google confirms the Pixel 11 will cost more than its predecessor, partly due to RAM supply issues linked to AI data centers. (Engadget, The Verge)
  • DeepSeek pauses fundraising after a leaked transcript reveals candid comments about the compute gap between China and the US, sparking debate on HN. (GitHub PDF)
  • Community projects shine: JetZero's blended-wing aircraft, an ESP32-based plane radar, and a map of every US golf course capture the maker spirit on Hacker News. (JetZero, blog.ktz.me, golfcoursebrowser.com)

Watch next: Keep an eye on SpaceX's next Starship tower catch attempt, the EU's escalating action against TikTok over minors' safety, and the fallout from DeepSeek's fundraising pause as it signals growing tensions in the global AI race.

汽车 · 11 items

The automotive desk is dominated by BYD's contrasting fortunes—global expansion versus domestic margin pressure—and new data on autonomous driving safety. Waymo's IIHS-backed safety claim is tempered by operational caveats, while Tesla faces regulatory pushback over FSD marketing. The electric truck and micromobility segments also see notable developments.

  • BYD's Global Sales Surge Masks a Home-Market Contraction That's Hitting Margins — BYD's global sales surge masks a home-market contraction hitting margins.
  • Waymo crashes 1/3 as much as a human driver, says IIHS – with some caveats — Waymo's autonomous taxis are 68% safer than human drivers, but the data is limited to its operational area.
  • Tesla Said FSD Can Handle Whiteouts. Now Federal Regulators Want Receipts. — Tesla's marketing claims attract federal scrutiny; regulators demand evidence.
  • Another state may legalize electric motorbikes up to 30 and 40 mph under sweeping new micromobility bill — Massachusetts considers a broad micromobility framework that would legalize faster electric bikes and scooters.
  • Windrose says 10 of its electric semi trucks are coming to Texas’ I-35 corridor — A new electric Class 8 truck deployment on a key freight route, though caveats remain (allegedly).

Signal: The automotive sector is at a tipping point: EV leaders face domestic pressures, autonomy gains credibility but also regulatory heat, and micromobility legislation could reshape urban transport.

News Radar — 体育新闻

2026-07-26 · Window: 24h · Items: 40 · Generated: 2026-07-26 04:41 UTC

Editor's Brief

The last 24 hours delivered a mix of high drama and strategic moves across major sports. Anthony Joshua survived two knockdowns to stop Kristian Prenga, setting up a megafight with Tyson Fury. Luke Littler continued his darting rampage at the World Matchplay, while Lando Norris seized pole in Hungary. In cycling, Tadej Pogacar stands on the brink of a record-equalling fifth Tour de France title. Badminton’s China Open saw Chinese stars dominate, and basketball fans followed the curious roster swap involving Quentin Grimes and LeBron James.

  • Joshua vs. Fury is set: Anthony Joshua recovered from being knocked down twice inside 20 seconds to knock out Kristian Prenga in Jeddah, dedicating the win to late friends. The victory rubberstamps a blockbuster showdown with Tyson Fury later this year. Joshua-Fury moves closer as AJ KOs Prenga Joshua devotes win to late friends
  • Littler on course for history: 19-year-old Luke Littler reached the World Matchplay final and is on track to break Phil Taylor’s tournament average record. He will face Gerwyn Price. Littler sets up Price final at World Matchplay
  • Norris leads in Hungary: Lando Norris took pole for the Hungarian Grand Prix, calling McLaren’s pace “new man’s land,” while Lewis Hamilton faces a penalty and vows to fight back. Norris cautious despite pole
  • Pogacar on verge of fifth Tour title: Tadej Pogacar is poised to equal the record for most Tour de France wins after Richard Carapaz won a dramatic stage 20 to Alpe d’Huez. Paris awaits as Pogacar poised
  • China Open badminton: Chen Yufei and mixed doubles in focus: Chinese shuttlers secured gold and silver in multiple categories, with Chen Yufei advancing to the women’s singles final. France’s Toma Junior Popov reached his first final. 2026年中国羽毛球公开赛半决赛综述 中国羽球公开赛：法选手大波波夫
  • Quentin Grimes trains with Lakers as James heads to Philly: Lakers guard Quentin Grimes posted training photos in Lakers gear, with fans noting the irony that LeBron James is moving to the 76ers—the team Grimes just left. 轨迹相反！格兰姆斯ins晒出训练照

多频道新闻雷达 — 娱乐新闻

2026-07-26 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 74 · 生成时间: 2026-07-26 04:41 UTC

板块速览

今日娱乐头条被圣迭戈动漫展（SDCC）全面接管，漫威在Hall H连放三颗重磅炸弹：Ryan Gosling版恶灵骑士、David Jonsson版黑豹之子和《复仇者联盟：末日》预告，直接引爆全球粉丝圈。欧美区外，Katy Perry罕见怒怼白宫滥用其歌曲、Tom Holland自嘲烂片经历也引发热议。日韩方面，TXT在KM Chart Awards斩获五项大奖成为年度艺人，《特工金》以23%收视率收官。国内微博则被卢昱晓道歉、李权哲高铁占座、刘亦菲国籍旧照等争议刷屏，娱乐圈的“人设”与“边界”议题再次浮出水面。

  • Katy Perry ‘Deeply Appalled’ After White House Uses ‘Firework’ in Military Strikes TikTok Video — 她公开表示音乐是团结而非战争工具，白宫此举引发政治与娱乐交叉争议。
  • Marvel’s Comic-Con Panel Excites Fans for ‘Doomsday’ but Leaves Them Cautiously Optimistic About What’s Beyond — 除了《末日》预告，Ryan Gosling的恶灵骑士和David Jonsson的黑豹3定档2028，漫威未来牌面清晰但粉丝仍嫌不足。
  • Tom Holland Admits Some Of His Movies Were Hard To Promote “Because It’s Sh*t” — 荷兰弟坦率发言令舆论哗然，却也为其敬业形象加分。
  • Winners Of The KM Chart Awards (KMA) 2026 — TXT凭五座奖杯登顶，KMA巩固了K-pop新生代格局。
  • 分享日常意外踩业内禁忌！卢昱晓一错再错发文道歉爆了热搜 — 因分享日常踩中行业禁忌，连续道歉反而引爆热搜，暴露新生代艺人“边界感”缺失。
  • 刘亦菲美国初中班级合照曝光！她是美国人，来中国赚钱很受欢迎 — 旧照疑再次引发对其国籍与市场定位的讨论。

后续观察： Comic-Con后续效应将持续发酵，特别是《黑豹3》选角争议与《报仇者联盟》剧情走向；日韩剧集收视大洗牌，值得追踪新剧《Love on the Menu》能否接棒；国内艺人的社交分享“雷区”正成为新的公关考验。

欧美 · 43 条

圣迭戈动漫展（SDCC）是今日欧美区的绝对主角。漫威在Hall H一口气放出《复仇者联盟：末日》预告、Ryan Gosling联手Shawn Levy的《恶灵骑士》独立电影（2028年）以及David Jonsson饰演T'Challa儿子、定档2028年底的《黑豹3》。此外Ryan Reynolds以死侍装扮乱入乞求角色，将气氛推向高潮。另一条重量级非漫威新闻是Mike Flanagan版《Carrie》剧集首曝预告，定档10月7日。

  • Ryan Gosling Unveiled As Ghost Rider At Marvel’s Comic-Con Panel — 从传闻变现实，高司令入局MCU，话题与票房潜力兼备。
  • ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Trailer Rocks Comic-Con: Doctor Doom Raises Army of Sentinels... — 杜姆博士带领哨兵大军对阵复联+神奇四侠+X战警，格局铺得极大。
  • ‘Carrie’ Schools Comic-Con With Prime Video Release Date, Trailer... — 现代高中校园暴力的恐怖改编，流媒体竞争加剧。
  • Warner Bros. Sues Amazon, Accusing Company of “Seeking to Pirate Away Employees” — 华纳起诉亚马逊挖角高层，行业人才争夺白热化。 漫威的“终局之后”叙事通过本次SDCC清晰起来，但粉丝对后续规划（如2027空窗期）仍存谨慎乐观。

News Radar — 娱乐新闻

2026-07-26 · Window: 24h · Items: 74 · Generated: 2026-07-26 04:41 UTC

Editor's Brief

The last 24 hours were dominated by Marvel's massive Comic-Con panel, which unveiled major casting and release dates, while a political controversy erupted around Katy Perry. In China, celebrity scandals and social media storms captured public attention, and Korea celebrated its KM Chart Awards. Below are the key developments shaping today's entertainment landscape.

  • Marvel Studios' Comic-Con panel was the headline event, with announcements including Ryan Gosling as Ghost Rider (Deadline), David Jonsson as T'Challa's son in Black Panther 3 (Variety), and the Avengers: Doomsday trailer raising an army of Sentinels (Variety).
  • Katy Perry publicly condemned the White House for using her song 'Firework' in a military strikes TikTok video, calling it 'deeply appalled' (Rolling Stone). The incident underscores the tension between artists and political institutions.
  • Tom Holland admitted some of his past films were 'sh*t' and hard to promote, contrasting with his current blockbusters (Deadline). This candid remark may fuel discussions about actor authenticity.
  • Warner Bros. filed a lawsuit against Amazon, accusing the company of poaching employees and unfair competition (Hollywood Reporter). This legal battle could reshape talent retention strategies in Hollywood.
  • In Korea, TXT dominated the KM Chart Awards, winning five awards including Artist of the Year (Soompi). Meanwhile, Agent Kim Reactivated ended with a 23% rating, the highest of 2026 (Soompi).
  • Chinese social media buzzed with controversies: singer Li Quanzhe accused of seat hogging on high-speed rail (Sina), and actor Lu Yuxiao apologizing for a social media post (Sina).
  • Liu Yifei's US middle school photo went viral, reigniting debate over her nationality and career in China (Sina).
  • Wang Junkai's studio engaged in 'reverse push' by asking fans to stop demanding updates, sparking a trending topic (Sina).

Watch next: As Comic-Con wraps, expect detailed reactions from fans and critics to Marvel's slate, particularly the Avengers: Doomsday trailer. The Katy Perry-White House clash may escalate if more artists speak out. In China, the Li Quanzhe incident could lead to official statements, while Lu Yuxiao's apology may test fan loyalty. Korean drama ratings for new premieres like Love on the Menu will be closely watched.

欧美 · 43 items

The 欧美 desk saw a flurry of activity from San Diego Comic-Con, with major Marvel announcements dominating the news cycle. Additionally, a political music controversy and a corporate lawsuit added depth to the day's coverage.

  • Marvel's Comic-Con panel revealed Ryan Gosling as Ghost Rider (Deadline) and David Jonsson as T'Challa's son in Black Panther 3 (Hollywood Reporter), with a 2028 release date. The Avengers: Doomsday trailer teased an epic showdown (Variety).
  • Katy Perry voiced outrage over the White House using her song in a military TikTok, stating her music is 'for bringing people together' (Rolling Stone). This could trigger a broader debate about political use of copyrighted music.
  • Tom Holland admitted some past films were 'sh*t', offering a rare candid moment from a star known for diplomacy (Deadline).
  • Prime Video's Carrie series dropped a trailer and set an October 7 release date, with Mike Flanagan teasing a 'big surprise' (Deadline).
  • Coyote vs. Acme finally screened at Comic-Con after being shelved, with director Dave Green calling the fight worth it (Variety).

The day's news signals a strategic pivot for Marvel, a growing rift between artists and political bodies, and a vindication for shelved projects.

多频道新闻雷达 — 经济新闻

2026-07-25 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 125 · 生成时间: 2026-07-25 04:27 UTC

板块速览

过去24小时，全球市场在多重冲击下剧烈波动。美国新关税生效即遭起诉，特朗普同时威胁对欧盟加征“实质性关税”，叠加伊朗战争推高油价至100美元/桶，美股科技板块承压，特斯拉单周暴跌18%。欧洲央行维持利率不变但鹰派信号明确，市场押注9月加息，欧元区企业提价困难。中国方面，Trip.com遭反垄断重罚5.2亿元，证监会原副主席方星海被查，但港股在改革和ETF资金流入下强势反弹。同花顺社区热议监管风暴与资金流向。整体来看，贸易摩擦、能源危机与政策不确定性构成当前市场主线。

  • 特朗普关税战升级：新关税生效数小时后即被起诉，专家质疑其法律基础；同时特朗普威胁对欧盟征收“实质性关税”，指控欧盟“抢劫”美国科技巨头。Trump sued hours after new tariffs take effect ｜ Trump threatens EU with 'substantial TARIFF'
  • 特斯拉遭遇2022年以来最差单周：财报不及预期、现金流转负，股价周跌幅近18%，马斯克“糟糕的一周”还包括SpaceX IPO后首次星舰试飞前股价下跌。Musk's bad week: Tesla suffers worst slump
  • 债券市场对AI资本支出感到焦虑：谷歌、亚马逊、Meta信用利差走阔，固定收益投资者要求更高回报，质疑巨额AI投入的回报前景。Bond market anxiety is growing over AI capex
  • 欧洲央行维持利率不变但偏鹰：能源价格高企强化9月加息预期，欧元区企业调查显示提价困难，消费者通胀预期仍待观察。ECB Keeps Tightening Bias as Energy Prices Strengthen Case for September Hike
  • 中国反垄断重拳出击：Trip.com因滥用市场支配地位被罚7.65亿美元，为在线旅游领域最大罚单；同时证监会原副主席方星海被调查，释放强监管信号。China hits Trip.com with US$765 million antitrust penalty ｜ China places former deputy of top financial regulator under investigation
  • 宁德时代创纪录季度利润：二季度营收1477.9亿元、净利润225亿元均创历史新高，但电动车需求放缓拖累部分预期，公司同步宣布A股史上最大单次回购。CATL posts record quarterly profits ｜ 宁德时代回应发起A股史上最大单次回购
  • 港股迎来八年最大改革：香港交易所允许所有上市申请保密提交，降低初创及国际公司市值门槛，旨在吸引更多IPO。Hong Kong exchange’s biggest reform in 8 years opens gates to more IPOs
  • 资金动向：宽基ETF单周净流入超500亿元，7月24日单日ETF净流入205.77亿元，显示机构资金在市场震荡中加速布局。本周宽基ETF净流入超500亿

后续观察：下周需重点关注：1）美国对欧盟关税威胁的后续进展及欧盟反制措施；2）特斯拉财报后的市场情绪修复，以及SpaceX星舰试飞结果对母公司估值的影响；3）中国监管风暴是否扩大到更多科技平台；4）欧洲PMI数据公布后对欧元走势的指引。地缘政治（海湾战争）与货币政策（鹰派联储&欧央行）的交叉影响将持续主导风险资产定价。

美股 · 62 条

美股本周以科技股领跌，特斯拉单周暴跌18%成为最大拖累，同时债券市场对AI资本支出的担忧加剧，信用利差走阔。特朗普关税政策再起波澜——新关税遭起诉，且威胁对欧盟加税，加重市场不确定性。SpaceX在IPO后首次试飞星舰，成败将影响太空概念股情绪。

  • Tesla suffers worst slump since 2022 — 财报不及预期和现金流转负是下跌主因
  • Bond market anxiety over AI capex — 谷歌、亚马逊、Meta信用利差扩大，市场质疑AI投资回报
  • Trump tariffs challenged in court — 新关税生效数小时后即遭到起诉，法律挑战或削弱政策效力
  • Trump threatens EU with tariffs — 特朗普在社交媒体指责欧盟“抢劫”美科技巨头
  • SpaceX Starship test flight since IPO — 星舰试飞是IPO后首次重大测试，市场屏息关注 总体看，美股短期面临关税政策反复、科技龙头业绩放缓和AI开支质疑三重压力，波动率可能上升。

item.content:encoded:
News Radar — 经济新闻

2026-07-25 · Window: 24h · Items: 125 · Generated: 2026-07-25 04:27 UTC

Editor's Brief

Global markets are navigating a complex landscape shaped by renewed US tariffs, an oil price spike tied to Middle East tensions, and diverging central bank stances. The ECB held rates steady but maintained a hawkish bias, while bond markets grow anxious over AI capex budgets. In China, regulators imposed a landmark antitrust fine on Trip.com, while HKEX unveiled major listing reforms. The week also saw Tesla's worst slump since 2022 and SpaceX's first Starship test flight post-IPO. Below are the key developments across desks.

  • Tariffs Escalate & Oil Shock: President Trump imposed new 25% tariffs on Brazilian imports and threatened 50% on Canadian goods, sparking an immediate lawsuit. Separately, Trump threatened the EU with 'substantial tariff' over tech fines. Combined with a Persian Gulf war pushing oil past $100/barrel, the global economy faces a stagflationary jolt (CNBC, NYT).
  • ECB Holds Firm, September Hike Priced In: The ECB kept rates unchanged but signaled a tightening bias amid rising energy prices. Traders now see a September hike as likely, while the euro strengthened as the dollar also gained on safe-haven flows (FOREX.com, Moomoo).
  • Bond Market Anxious Over AI Capex: Credit spreads on Google, Amazon, and Meta are widening as fixed-income investors demand higher rewards for lending to companies with massive AI spending plans (CNBC).
  • Tesla Plunges, SpaceX Test Flight: Tesla shares fell nearly 18% on earnings miss and negative cash flow, while SpaceX launched its Starship rocket in its first test flight since last month's IPO – a pivotal moment for Musk's empire (CNBC, CNBC).
  • China Fines Trip.com $765M, HKEX Reforms: China's market regulator hit Trip.com with a record antitrust penalty for monopolistic conduct. Meanwhile, HKEX announced its biggest listing reforms in 8 years, allowing confidential filings and lowering thresholds for startups (SCMP, SCMP).
  • Record CATL Profit but EV Demand Soft: CATL posted record quarterly revenue and profit, but still missed estimates as China's EV demand weakened, highlighting a mixed outlook for the battery giant (SCMP).
  • Community Buzz: ETF Inflows & Watchdog Probe: Chinese retail investors noted over 500 billion yuan in weekly ETF inflows and the investigation of former CSRC vice-chair Fang Xinghai, signaling continued state intervention in markets (同花顺, 同花顺).

Watch next: All eyes are on the Federal Reserve's task force announcement on monetary policy conduct, and the outcome of Trump's tariff lawsuits. In Europe, the ECB's September decision will be heavily influenced by oil prices and PMI data due next week. China's antitrust actions and HKEX reform implementation will be key for market sentiment in Asia.

美股 · 62 items

US equities face a volatile mix of renewed tariff escalations, an oil price spike, and diverging corporate fortunes. Tesla suffered its worst weekly slump since 2022, while SpaceX's Starship test flight dominated headlines. Bond markets are signaling unease over AI spending.

  • Tariff Shock & Legal Battle: Trump's new 25% tariffs on Brazil and 50% threat on Canada face an immediate lawsuit; experts question their durability. Separately, Trump threatened the EU with 'substantial tariff' over tech fines (CNBC, CNBC).
  • Musk's Turbulent Week: Tesla shares plunged 18% after a weak earnings report and negative cash flow. Meanwhile, SpaceX launched its Starship rocket in the first test flight since its IPO – a high-stakes moment for Musk's reputation (CNBC, CNBC).
  • Bond Market Anxiety on AI Capex: Google, Amazon, and Meta see widening credit spreads as fixed-income investors demand higher compensation for AI-related capital expenditure risks (CNBC).
  • Paramount-WBD Delay & Uber-Waymo Shift: Paramount agreed to delay its Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition to June 2027 amid legal challenges. Uber and Waymo will end exclusivity in Atlanta and Austin by 2028 (CNBC, CNBC).
  • Tech Wealth Boom Drives Auction Records: Auction houses report nearly $10 billion in H1 sales, fueled by tech wealth chasing dinosaur bones, art, and watches (CNBC).

Signal: The combination of tariff uncertainty, oil at $100, and AI capex skepticism suggests a risk-off tilt in the near term, but tech IPO activity (SpaceX) and wealth effects continue to provide pockets of strength.

item.content:encoded:
多频道新闻雷达 — 社会新闻

2026-07-25 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 75 · 生成时间: 2026-07-25 04:27 UTC

板块速览

今日全球社会新闻呈现两条主线：地缘冲突持续升温与国内社会治理议题交织。美伊在波斯湾互相打击，中东紧张推高全球油价；俄乌战场无人机展遭袭，乌防长被撤引发政治危机。同时，欧洲野火迫使超22万人撤离，彰显气候危机紧迫。国内方面，中国基础教育成就与菲尔兹奖得主热议形成对照，知乎社区则因营收下滑与AI转型引发讨论。

  • 美伊在波斯湾互相打击，紧张局势升级：伊朗谴责美国计划用冻结资产支付战争赔款，特朗普称“已锁定目标”并寻求谈判，但冲突风险持续升高。
  • 俄军导弹袭击基辅附近无人机展，10人死亡：乌克兰国防工业重要人物出席，事件暴露战时集会安全脆弱性。泽连斯基因解除国防部长职务引发持续抗议，政治压力加大。
  • 法西野火肆虐，超22万人撤离：波尔多附近火势蔓延，马德里称遭遇“史上最严重火灾”，气候变化影响愈发直接。
  • 特朗普出席白宫记者协会晚宴：调侃媒体，强调新闻自由，晚宴因4月枪击事件推迟。同日他又命令史密森尼博物馆标注“不准确”历史，持续争夺叙事权。
  • 国际刑事法院首席检察官因性行为不端被免职：卡里姆·汗否认指控，但事件动摇ICC公信力。
  • 澳洲家庭面临加息与油价突破2澳元：中东危机推升原油至100美元以上，全球通胀风险再起。

后续观察：中东局势若进一步恶化，将直接冲击全球能源市场和地缘政治格局，尤其对依赖进口的亚洲经济体带来连锁压力。同时，欧美内部政治角力（美国历史叙事、ICC信任危机）与气候灾难叠加，预示下半年社会治理难度上升。

欧美 · 39 条

中东战火与欧洲野火成为今日欧美两大焦点，美国内部政治亦未平静。美伊军事对峙升级，特朗普一方面展示强硬，另一方面又放话谈判，矛盾信号令市场不安；欧洲南部高温干旱助长野火，法国西班牙双双进入紧急状态。

  • 美伊互袭后特朗普称“锁定目标”但寻求谈判：伊朗谴责美国计划动用冻结资产支付战争赔款，双方在波斯湾的摩擦引发对全面冲突的担忧。
  • 法西野火迫使超22万人撤离，波尔多告急：法国消防员奋力阻止火势靠近波尔多，马德里宣布区域“最严重火灾”，气候危机正从预测变为现实。
  • 特朗普出席白宫记者协会晚宴并调侃媒体：这是4月枪击事件后的补办活动，特朗普借此强化个人形象；同日他下令史密森尼博物馆标注“不准确历史”，持续推动文化战争。
  • 俄军导弹袭击基辅附近无人机展致10死：乌克兰国防工业代表遭精准打击，泽连斯基因解除防长职务引发国内政治风波，批评者认为其政治资本受损。

欧美社会当前处于多重压力叠加期：战争、野火、政治极化，三者相互激荡。短期内，市场对中东局势的敏感度将主导风险情绪。

日韩 · 15 条

日韩今日新闻聚焦制度变革与历史叙事：日本设立新情报机构强化国家安全，韩国则在世界杯失利后反思体制，同时通过归还文物改善对华关系。经济层面，日元疲软与珠宝消费创新高形成对照。

  • 日本将于7月底启动新情报机构及监督机构：此举旨在增强对外情报收集与内部监督能力，反映日本安全政策持续转型。
  • 韩国世界杯出局引发体制审视：舆论开始质疑青训体系与联赛质量，与日本足球的长期发展形成对比。
  • 韩国归还清朝石狮给中国，文化外交告捷：中方对此表示欢迎，此次归还被视为中韩关系回暖的积极信号。
  • 日本珠宝销售创纪录，日元贬值刺激消费：本土消费者趁日元低位购买高端珠宝，但分析师警告日元干预可能延后。

日韩正同步推进安全与外交调整，日本强化情报能力，韩国则在体育挫折后寻求文化修复。两国经济均受汇率波动影响，消费者行为分化明显。

中国 · 16 条

今日中国社会新闻以教育成就与宏观政策为主线。多篇报道聚焦基础教育自信、菲尔兹奖得主热议，以及教育部部署“十五五”规划。同时，社会稳定形势、医疗援外等正面议题持续释放信号。

  • 中国基础教育：规模普及与质量飞跃：通过数据和案例展示从“有学上”到“上好学”的转变，回应外界对中国教育质量的质疑。
  • 两位中国数学家获2026年菲尔兹奖，知乎热议：邓煜等天才获最高荣誉，但网络评价出现分化，折射出公众对学术明星的复杂心态。

item.content:encoded:
多频道新闻雷达 — 军事新闻

2026-07-25 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 60 · 生成时间: 2026-07-25 04:27 UTC

板块速览

军事新闻板块日报

导语： 过去24小时，全球军事冲突呈现多点联动、经济传导加速的态势。伊朗战争持续升级，美军连续第13天打击伊朗目标，霍尔木兹海峡通航量骤降，国际油价逼近110美元/桶，亚洲炼油商紧急寻找替代供应。与此同时，也门胡塞武装重启对沙特关联船只的封锁，红海与黑海航运同时受威胁，全球三大海上咽喉陷入危机。乌克兰战场出现新变量——首次使用荷兰“Ruta Block 1”巡航导弹，西方低成本远程打击能力加速实战化。中国周边，南海摩擦持续升温，菲律宾指责中方船只连续两日发射水炮，美国则扩大对华科研限制“黑名单”。以下为各子专栏详细分析。

  • 全球能源走廊遭多线攻击：霍尔木兹海峡、红海、黑海同时出现航运阻断事件。CNBC和Reuters均报道，伊朗与乌克兰战争导致物理原油价格飙升，部分合约接近110美元/桶。亚洲炼油商已开始寻找替代原油，市场恐慌情绪蔓延。Oil shipments are under attack on multiple fronts as fighting escalates in Red Sea, Hormuz and Black Sea - CNBC
  • 伊朗战争进入“永久危机”状态：Al Arabiya引述分析称美军在伊朗已展开“重大作战行动”，冲突长期化。美国中央司令部宣布摧毁一艘试图突破封锁的油轮，巴林也报告拦截了伊朗导弹袭击。伊朗则攻击美国在波斯湾的据点，战线扩大。Iran war: ‘We are in a major combat operation; This has become a perma-crisis’ - Al Arabiya English
  • 乌克兰首次使用荷兰Ruta巡航导弹：The War Zone报道，这种低成本巡航导弹的实战亮相标志着乌克兰加速向大规模远程打击能力转型。与此同时，乌克兰无人机部队在黑海猎杀俄船，据Defense News称已击中180余个海上目标。Evidence Of Ukraine Using Dutch Ruta Block 1 Cruise Missiles Emerges - The War Zone
  • 南海摩擦升级：菲指责中方水炮，多国声明搅局：菲律宾称中国海警船连续第二天对其公务船发射水炮。中国外交部回应菲律宾“蓄意挑衅”。王毅在马尼拉阐明立场，强调中国“稳定性与确定性”。十几个国家联合声明介入南海，中国媒体批其“露怯”。菲指责中方船只连续第二天对其公务船发射水炮 特朗普承诺将与习近平提及菲方关切 - RFI
  • 美国海军订购低成本导弹，对抗海上威胁：USNI News报道，美国海军通过CHAOS项目采购低成本巡航导弹，旨在扩大舰队和盟友的远程海上打击能力。同时，美国海岸警卫队开始寻求猎杀无人潜航器（UUV）的技术，以应对港口安全威胁。U.S. Navy Orders Low-cost Missiles to Expand Fleet, Allied Long-Range Maritime Strike Capabilities - USNI News
  • 德国撤回拟部署霍尔木兹的海军舰艇：Defense News报道，鉴于伊朗战争看不到结束迹象，德国国防部决定撤回原计划用于战后霍尔木兹任务的两艘海军舰艇。这一决定凸显欧洲盟友对冲突长期化的评估。With no Iran war end in sight, Germany pulls back two navy ships eyed for Hormuz mission - Defense News
  • 美国扩大对华科研限制“黑名单”，多所顶尖大学上榜：美国之音报道，五角大楼将多家中国企业和大学列入“中国军事企业清单”，包括之前未涉及的高校。此举将进一步加剧中美科技脱钩。五角大楼扩大科研限制“黑名单”，中国多所顶尖大学首次上榜 - 美国之音

后续观察： 霍尔木兹海峡与红海的封锁正在形成“航运危机共振”，国际油价可能在近期突破110美元并引发全球经济连锁反应。伊朗战争若再持续数周，欧洲盟友的军事承诺将出现裂痕（德国撤舰只是开始）。南海方向，中国与菲律宾的摩擦可能在下周东盟外长会期间激化。乌克兰使用荷兰巡航导弹意味着西方对乌远程打击的限制进一步放松，俄军后方目标将面临更大威胁。

冲突局势 · 12 条

概览： 全球三大能源海峡同时告急——霍尔木兹、红海、黑海均出现武装冲突阻断航运，国际油价单日飙升逼近110美元。伊朗与美国在波斯湾的互相打击已进入第13天，胡塞武装重启对沙特船只的封锁，乌克兰也指控俄罗斯在效仿伊朗封锁黑海。

  • 也门政府承诺不利用领土威胁邻国与海上安全，但胡塞武装的行动表明该组织仍在挑战国际航运。 Yemeni government vows not to let territory threaten neighbors, maritime security - Anadolu Ajansı
  • 霍尔木兹海峡通航量较前一周骤降超一半，亚洲炼油商紧急寻找替代原油来源。 Asian refiners look for alternative crude as Middle East prices rise - Baird Maritime
  • 乌克兰外长西比哈指责俄罗斯采取与伊朗类似手段封锁黑海，航运安全进一步恶化。 Russia is doing to Black Sea what Iran is doing to Strait of Hormuz - Sybiha - ukranews.com
  • 英国皇家国际事务研究所（Chatham House）发文质疑：面对胡塞武装的封锁，集体海上安全体系能否被有效防御还是将崩溃。 The Houthi Red Sea blockade: Will collective maritime security be defended, or break down? - Chatham House

News Radar — 军事新闻

2026-07-25 · Window: 24h · Items: 60 · Generated: 2026-07-25 04:27 UTC

Editor's Brief

The global security landscape is under acute multi-front stress as conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine converge to disrupt energy supplies, trigger record oil prices, and stretch naval resources. In the last 24 hours, the Strait of Hormuz transits have collapsed, Houthi blockades have resumed, and oil prices have surged toward $110/barrel, while the US and Iran continue trading strikes. Meanwhile, Ukraine strikes on Russian ships and Russian ballistic missile attacks on Kyiv escalate the war in Europe. In the Indo-Pacific, US-China tensions simmer over South China Sea incidents and a new Pentagon blacklist targeting Chinese universities. The US Navy advances low-cost allied strike capabilities even as Germany pulls back from Hormuz commitments.

  • Energy choke points on fire: Oil shipments are under attack across the Red Sea, Strait of Hormuz, and Black Sea (CNBC). Physical crude prices near $110 as Iran and Ukraine wars hit supply (Reuters).
  • US-Iran conflict deepens: US forces disabled an Iranian tanker after blockade attempts (NewsNation). Bahraini air defenses intercepted Iranian attacks (Iran International).
  • Houthi Red Sea blockade deepens: A Chatham House analysis questions whether collective maritime security will hold (Chatham House).
  • Ukraine war escalates: A Ukrainian drone unit hunting Russian ships has hit over 180 vessels (Defense News). Russia struck a defense industry exhibition near Kyiv, killing at least 10 (Facebook).
  • Naval force posture shifting: Germany pulls back two navy ships eyed for a Hormuz mission amid no end to Iran war (Defense News). The White House protests a congressional block on buying foreign warships for the US Navy (USNI News).
  • US Navy pursues low-cost allied strike missiles: The CHAOS program selects CoAspire to deliver affordable long-range maritime strike munitions (USNI News).
  • China-Philippines confrontation escalates: Philippines accuses Chinese vessels of water cannon attacks for the second day; Trump pledges to raise the issue with Xi (RFI). Chinese state media denounce Japan-Philippines collusion (国际在线).
  • Pentagon expands blacklist: US adds several top Chinese universities to its research restriction blacklist (美国之音).

Watch next: Oil prices may breach $110 as Strait of Hormuz traffic remains at a trickle; watch for further US-Iran strikes and potential Iranian retaliation on Gulf states. The RIMPAC exercise continues, while South China Sea incidents could trigger a new crisis hotline call. The Pentagon's ban on foreign warship purchases will be a key NDAA battleground.

冲突局势 · 12 items

The conflict landscape is dominated by the convergence of three simultaneous maritime choke-point crises — the Strait of Hormuz, the Red Sea, and the Black Sea — driving oil prices toward $110 and forcing Asian refiners to scramble for alternative crude. Yemen's government has vowed not to let its territory threaten neighbors, but Houthi actions belie that pledge, with a renewed blockade against Saudi-linked shipping. The Iran war is described as a 'perma-crisis' by Al Arabiya, with both sides striking military sites.

  • Oil price shock: Physical crude prices near $110 due to supply disruptions from Iran and Ukraine wars (BOE Report).
  • Hormuz closure hits real economy: Supermarket prices already rising due to Strait of Hormuz closure (OilPrice.com).
  • US and Iran trade strikes: Iran targets US strongholds around the Gulf; US hits more Iranian military sites (Tribune-Democrat).
  • Russia parallels Hormuz: Ukraine’s Foreign Minister Sybiha likens Russian Black Sea actions to Iran’s Hormuz blockade (ukranews.com).

Signal: The multi-theater disruption of energy shipping is now a first-order economic threat; watch for coordinated naval responses or further escalation as insurance and freight costs spiral.

International security headlines are dominated by the expanding US-Iran conflict, Ukraine's persistent long-range strikes, and technological developments in naval and air power. US forces disabled a tanker after blockade attempts, while Bahrain confirmed intercepting Iranian attacks. Ukraine continues to innovate with drone warfare and Dutch Ruta cruise missiles, while Russia retaliates with ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv. Defense industrial developments include Turkey's mass production phase, UK's Tempest demonstrator imagery, and the B-21 production ramp.

  • US disables tanker, Bahrain intercepts: CENTCOM confirmed disabling a tanker after blockade attempts (NewsNation). Bahrain says air defenses intercepted Iranian attacks (Iran International).
  • Ukraine strikes deep: A Ukrainian drone unit operating far behind the front line has hit over 180 vessels (Defense News). Evidence emerges of Ukraine using Dutch Ruta Block 1 cruise missiles in combat (The War Zone).
  • Russia strikes Kyiv area: Ballistic missiles hit a defense industry exhibition outside Kyiv, killing at least 10 and injuring nearly 100 (Facebook). Ukrainian air defenses shot down one Iskander missile and 81 drones (Ukrinform).
  • Defense tech advances: UK reveals more images of its stealth fighter demonstrator for Tempest (The War Zone). US Coast Guard seeks technology to hunt and kill UUVs (The War Zone). B-21 production ramp-up deal includes pathway to larger fleet (The War Zone).

Signal: Ukraine's shift to mass-produced long-range strike capabilities and Russia's ballistic missile terror tactics are reshaping the battlefield; the US-Iran conflict is drawing in regional partners like Bahrain, while defense industrial base investments signal a long-term competition.

Chinese state media accuse Japan and the Philippines of collusion, while the US expands its Pentagon blacklist to include several top Chinese universities. Foreign Minister Wang Yi's visit to Manila aims to assert Chinese stability and counter US influence. Taiwan's DPP is criticized for diverging from the national line on the South China Sea.

  • Pentagon blacklist expanded: US adds multiple top Chinese universities to research restriction list (美国之音). US also adds some Chinese companies to 'Chinese military enterprise list', prompting Ministry of Commerce response (财联社).
  • Wang Yi in Manila: Chinese Foreign Minister clarifies South China Sea stance, presenting China as a force of 'stability and certainty' (thepaper.cn).
  • Japan-Philippines collusion denounced: Chinese media and official sources criticize Japan for hyping Taiwan Strait and South China Sea issues (人民网).

Signal: The South China Sea is becoming a focal point of US-China competition; the water cannon incident and Trump's involvement indicate potential for direct presidential intervention. The Pentagon's expanding blacklist signals deepening tech decoupling.
